**Job Title: Senior Dot Net Engineer**

**Location:** **Manchester**


**About the Job you are considering:**


Join Capgemini’s Cloud \& Custom Applications (C\&CΑ) practice, where we help clients transform business outcomes through modern application engineering, intelligent automation, and AI\-enabled innovation. Guided by our vision to Consult with Purpose. Continuously Evolve. Architect Tomorrow., we are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can build scalable digital solutions while embracing emerging AI capabilities. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality customer outcomes, contribute to a future\-ready workforce, and support the adoption of AI\-driven approaches that enhance productivity, innovation, and business value.


**Hybrid working:**

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Deliver scalable, high\-quality application solutions that address business and customer needs.
* Design and develop intuitive digital experiences that improve usability, accessibility, and operational efficiency.
* Build and integrate services that enable seamless data flow and business process automation.
* Contribute to the adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities that drive innovation and productivity improvements.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to achieve successful outcomes.
* Participate in solution design discussions, ensuring long\-term scalability, maintainability, and resilience.
* Maintain high engineering standards through testing, peer reviews, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.
* Investigate and resolve complex technical challenges while promoting best practices and quality outcomes.
* Optimise application performance, reliability, and user experience across the solution lifecycle.
* Support a culture of continuous learning, AI fluency, and future\-ready capability development.

**Required Skill:**


* Strong experience in full\-stack application development within enterprise environments.
* Proficiency in C\#, .NET, and modern front\-end development.
* Experience designing, developing, and supporting scalable web applications.
* Strong understanding of API design, systems integration, and distributed application architectures.
* Expertise in relational database design, data modelling, performance optimisation, and data management.
* Experience working throughout the software development lifecycle within Agile delivery teams.
* Practical experience applying AI\-assisted development approaches to improve delivery efficiency and quality.
* Knowledge of intelligent automation, agent\-based workflows, and AI\-enabled application solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration skills.
* Commitment to continuous learning and adopting emerging technologies and AI capabilities.

**We are a Disability Confident Employer:**


Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


* Declare they have a disability, and
* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.


**Make It Real (what does it mean for you):**


* You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024\. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
  

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
* You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
* You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

**Why you should consider Capgemini:**


Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free\-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.


**About Capgemini:**


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.
  

Make it real \| www.capgemini.com

We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Are you a highly motivated multi\-disciplinary engineer looking to work on building projects that can change the world, projects that are always more complex and innovative than the last?


We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineer to join our MEP team. This is a hybrid role and you could be based in our London, Croydon, St.Albans, Manchester, Leeds, Exeter, Cardiff or Bristol office to work across a broad range of sectors and for a broad range of clients. You will be joining a team of like\-minded experts that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.

 **About Us:**

AECOM plays a critical role in the conceptualisation and creation of amazing spaces, delivering projects and buildings that define skylines and communities. AECOM Buildings \& Places – Design is made up of dedicated teams delivering projects in Commercial, Residential, Hospitality, Sports Venues, Work Places, Data Centres, Education, Government, Healthcare and Defence.


We are friendly, busy and motivated with an established track record of successfully delivering local and overseas projects. Some of our flagship work in recent years include:

* **Healthcare**: AECOM is a leading award\-winning consultant for the NHS in the UK and internationally, delivering projects ranging from major acute hospitals to primary care and estate refurbishment schemes, while supporting the NHS Net Zero Carbon agenda.
* **Decarbonisation**: Multiple projects where we have undertaken the feasibility of the removal of boilers and installation of Air Source and Water source heat pumps to provide the heating and cooling for the building. Projects include commercial buildings like 80 – 100 Victoria Street London, British Library, multiple residential buildings in the Royal Borough of Greenwich and even Windsor Castle.
* **Stratford Cross**: A major mixed\-use regeneration development in Stratford, East London, located within the former Olympic Park area. Our team are providing multi\-discipline services including MEP, civil \& structural, vertical transportation, energy \& sustainability, acoustics, air quality, ecology, transport, waste management, and façade engineering.
* **Data Centres**: Working for multiple major hyperscale projects in the Nordics, Iberia and South America. These projects provide the opportunity to tackle the issue of data management and storage specific to each country. Designing and implementing a highly resilient electrical infrastructure entails the usage of an efficient system that is highly sustainable.
* **Lansdowne House**: High\-end commercial office development occupying the South\-East side of Berkley Square, Mayfair, City of Westminster, with an all\- electric energy centre containing Ground Source Heat Pumps, Air Source Heat Pumps and High Efficiency Chillers.
* **10 Dock:** Western Europe’s largest naval dockyard in Plymouth, a defence project of enormous scale and multiple components that must come together as a solution to meet a new capability.

 **About Our Team:**


Our award\-winning and close\-knit Building Services team have a strong presence across sectors and we have and a strong Public Health engineering team throughout the UK. The team is seeking to expand their capabilities further by adding a Senior Public Health Engineer with experience in delivering sustainable projects across multiple sectors, has excellent team working and co\-ordination skills and strives for technical excellence.


You will be an integral part of the diverse and dynamic national AECOM PH team which will support your technical career development. Challenges such as the net zero agenda and water neutrality provide great opportunities for your career to flourish with the role also including Fire Protection systems design which will be supported by our experienced specialist fire protection engineering team to provide the opportunity to develop new design skills. The position is predominantly office located role to ensure face\-to\-face contact time with the team.


The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self\-motivated, and looking to advance their career.

  

The role will include taking point lead on multiple PH systems design/calculations on a project as well as assisting the lead PH engineer with experience in the following systems:

* Hot and cold water systems
* Above ground foul and rainwater system
* Fire Protection Systems
* Below Ground drainage systems
* Pumped drainage systems
* Water and oil leak detection systems
* Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
* Water conservation solutions
* BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration


Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;

* Maintaining Client relationships
* Mentoring and developing staff
* Project Managing small sized multi\-disciplinary projects
* Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
* Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
* Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
* Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
* Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
* Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
* Support AECOM PM with input to pre\-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns
* Ensure the project work complies with the Project Management Plan and Programme
* Understand and implement AECOM’s Safety Health and Environment Policy

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Previous public health engineering work experience within design consultancy or other relevant business
* A comprehensive working knowledge of statutory regulations to ensure design compliance, make submissions to the statutory authorities and obtaining approvals as necessary
* Be able to work independently and have good time/task management skills
* Experience in mixed used, residential, commercial and healthcare buildings/sectors
* Fully competent in the use of AutoCad to produce 2D drawings
* Fully competence in using 3D Revit software and Navisworks reviewing software
* Ability to speak fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations

 **Qualifications**  

* Chartered Engineer with CIBSE / IET / IMechE (or working towards)
* BEng for a relevant engineering course (MEng preferred)
* CIBSE SoPHE Member

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

**Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity**


You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.


You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.


AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.


Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.


We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

### **About Us**



untypical is guided by its ambition to become the UK’s most customer\-centric housebuilder. By putting people and the planet at the heart of the communities that it builds, untypical aims to make a positive difference to the UK housebuilding market and help to provide greater access to homes which are affordable for buyers. We’re looking for talented and enthusiastic individuals who will share this passion, to join our team.



**Our benefits package includes:**


* Enhanced Pension Scheme
* Life Assurance
* 26 days holiday with additional bank holidays
* Holiday Buy Scheme
* Employee Assistance Programme
### **About The Role**


untypical is seeking a HubSpot CRM Developer for a 12\-18 month fixed\-term contract. The role will lead the hands\-on design, configuration, development and integration of HubSpot CRM as part of the business's digital transformation.



Working across IT and business teams, the postholder will translate requirements into secure, supportable solutions that improve lead management, customer engagement, reporting and operational efficiency. The role covers data migration, integrations, automation, testing, documentation and knowledge transfer into business\-as\-usual support.


**Responsibilities and Duties**


* + - Work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, IT and other stakeholders to define requirements, user journeys and delivery priorities.
	+ - Design and configure HubSpot objects, properties, associations, pipelines, views, permissions, workflows and automation in line with agreed business processes.
	+ - Develop and maintain integrations between HubSpot and core business systems, including websites, data platforms and COINS ERP where required.
	+ - Build secure integrations using HubSpot APIs, webhooks, private apps and appropriate authentication methods.
	+ - Plan and deliver data migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, deduplication, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
	+ - Improve lead capture, allocation, lifecycle management and hand\-offs between marketing, sales and customer service teams.
	+ - Create reliable CRM reporting and data structures that support operational insight and management information.
	+ - Establish controlled development, testing, release and rollback processes, using HubSpot sandbox capabilities where available.
	+ - Investigate defects and performance issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
	+ - Apply data governance, security, access control, retention and UK GDPR requirements across the CRM solution.
	+ - Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, data dictionaries, test evidence and support procedures.
	+ - Provide training, knowledge transfer and handover to internal teams so the solution can be supported effectively after the contract end.
	+ Create and manage hubspot design implementation.

### **About You**


**Essential:**


* Proven experience delivering HubSpot CRM implementations, development or major enhancement programmes in a hands\-on role.
* + Strong working knowledge of HubSpot CRM, including its data model, objects, properties, associations, pipelines, workflows, permissions and reporting.
* + Experience with relevant HubSpot hubs, particularly Sales Hub, Marketing Hub and Service Hub.
* + Practical integration experience using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth and private apps.
* + Development skills in JavaScript or Node.js; experience with another integration language such as Python or C\# is also valuable.
* + Experience of data migration, data mapping, cleansing and reconciliation, with a working knowledge of SQL or comparable query tools.
* + Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical designs and supportable CRM solutions.
* + Experience of testing, defect management, release control and production support.
* + Good understanding of CRM security, role\-based access, data governance and UK GDPR requirements.
* + Clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, suppliers and business stakeholders.
* Ability to manage priorities independently and deliver agreed outcomes within a fixed\-term programme.


* **Desirable**


	+ - Current HubSpot certifications relevant to CRM administration, development, integrations or solution architecture.
	+ - Experience with Breeze AI (Hubspots inbuilt AI module) andHubspots Chat GPT connector functionality.
	+ - Experience with Operations Hub, custom code actions, custom objects or programmable automation.
	+ - Experience with HubSpot CMS and HubL development.
	+ - Experience integrating HubSpot with ERP, finance, property, construction or data warehouse platforms.
	+ - Knowledge of COINS ERP, Microsoft Azure, Power BI, Git or automated deployment practices.
	+ Experience in housebuilding, construction, property or another multi\-site customer journey environment.

jobs.title: Java Engineer, Vice President
jobs.description:
Locations: **Edinburgh, United Kingdom**


  
**Job description**
-------------------


**About this role**


Our Engineering Services division is at the forefront building the foundation for Aladdin, an operating system for investment managers that integrates real\-time management of information, people, and technology. Aladdin is used by numerous financial institutions both internally and externally, and Developer Platform makes our application development teams faster and more consistent by providing centralized libraries, build and attestation (compliance) systems.


We own the SDLC languages (Java, Python, .NET, Rust, and Golang) used by the firm’s developers, both for organically grown and inorganically acquired applications. We succeed by helping our customers succeed, so understanding their business and technical problems is key to accelerating their delivery and ensuring consistency for legally required areas like compliance.


You'll join a supportive team with a healthy mix of experience levels, working alongside Directors and a Technical Fellow who set a high bar for technical excellence. This is a team where you'll be mentored, challenged, and given real ownership from day one.

  

  

As a Java Developer, you will strengthen the firm’s Java language support and help develop the shared platform capabilities used by financial applications operating at significant scale. These capabilities include libraries, build systems, database failover libraries, and shared business libraries maintained in partnership with application teams.

  

  

Java is the firm’s most mature programming language, creating complex engineering challenges across performance, reliability, scale, and developer experience. You will help address these challenges while also contributing expert guidance to the wider programming\-language community. Your work will support technology that helps investors pursue important financial goals, including saving for retirement, paying for education, purchasing a home, and improving their financial well\-being.

  

  

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following


responsibilities:


* Deliver practical engineering solutions within a complex operating environment, navigating multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strengthen the Java SDLC by developing and maintaining shared libraries, build systems, database failover capabilities, and application\-team\-owned business libraries.
* Address demanding performance, resilience, scalability, and survivability requirements for applications operating at significant scale.
* Contribute to the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) development tooling and evaluate how emerging engineering practices can improve delivery.
* Provide expert guidance to the wider programming\-language community and help improve the developer experience across the other languages supported by the team.
* Design, test, deploy, and support resilient systems while developing a strong understanding of how platform teams operate at scale.
* Collaborate with global engineering and application teams, share ideas, seek feedback, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
  

  

**Your experience**
-------------------


* Demonstrated software engineering experience and sound judgement gained through designing, delivering, and supporting production systems. Financial services experience is not required, and relevant practical experience is valued more than a specific degree.
* Strong Java programming experience and solid engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, version control, and writing clean, testable code.
* Demonstrated curiosity about how technologies work, with the motivation and adaptability to learn new programming languages, toolchains, and infrastructure.
* Interest in build systems, containers, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices, with a hands\-on approach to learning by building and improving solutions. Previous experience in these areas is helpful but not essential.
* A collaborative, team\-first approach, including following through on commitments, communicating openly, seeking feedback, and supporting colleagues.
* A proactive working style, with the ability to identify opportunities, raise issues early, and take ownership without waiting for detailed direction.
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical work and engineering decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences and ask questions when requirements are unclear.
  

  

**Our benefits**


To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well\-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.


**Our hybrid work model**


BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.  

  



  

**About BlackRock**

  

  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  

  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  

  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

  

  

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

We’re looking for a developer with a focus on front\-end technologies, particularly **React** , to help modernize our products. We’re not just looking for someone to build what’s in front of them — we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us, contribute ideas, and help shape the front\-end of our products. As all our developers work across the full stack, you should also be comfortable working with other technologies such as .NET, C\# and SQL Server.  



**Your Day with Equisoft:**

* Design and implement new features and products and build upon the application architecture for our range of software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) products. For us, this means writing code that is user centric, robust, high\-performance and secure.
* Most of your development time will be spent with .NET and C\# but we require all developers to work with our JavaScript front\-end and our SQL Server database as well.

**Technical**

* Comfortable working across a stack including C\#, .NET and SQL Server.
* Experience collaborating in small, cross\-functional teams.
Clear written and spoken English.  
* 

We care more about skill, curiosity, and drive than about degrees. If you’ve learned your craft through experience rather than academia, that’s absolutely fine.  



**Soft skills**

* Enthusiastic about software development, continued learning and improvement.
* A strong problem\-solver.
* A good eye for detail and show consideration for end\-user interactions.
* Initiative\-taking and enthusiastic.
* Strong sense of organization and prioritizing.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate, write and synthesize information.
* Ability to multi\-task in a rapid\-paced environment.
Team spirit, tact, diplomacy, autonomy, rigor, and discipline.  
* 

**Nice to Haves**

* Experience working within Agile Methodology.

An interest in financial services and/or pensions.

jobs.title: Senior software engineer - EU squad
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


London


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Hybrid


**Department**
--------------


Engineering


  
*Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team.*

  


**About us**
------------


Seccl is the Octopus\-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

  

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl\-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

  

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household\-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

  

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long\-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high\-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

  

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

  



**Our culture:**
----------------


**Never settle –** We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero\-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.


**Take ownership \-** We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long\-term scalability.


**Be generous \& candid \-** We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

  



**Our engineering ways of working:**
------------------------------------


* Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud \& Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.
* The squads are intentionally small and cross\-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.
* We operate in a build\-and\-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.
* Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in **TypeScript and Node.js,** with **MongoDB** as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C\# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.
* Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.
* We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

**The role**
------------


As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using **Typescript and Node.js.** You play a key role in our software development and have a hands\-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go\-to’ person for queries.

  


**On a typical day you will…**
------------------------------


* Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross\-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer\-facing and operations teams
* Design, implement and operate your services within your domain
* Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements
* Maintain and extend documentation for your services
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate
* Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers
* Communicate with non\-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

**What you need…**
------------------


* To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build\-and\-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.
* We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.
* Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.
* Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long\-term scalability.
* Experience building financial systems with multi\-region, multi\-currency or trading\-related complexity would be advantageous.
* Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.
* Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high\-quality, standards\-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.
* Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.
* Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.
* Willing to be on\-call for your services.

**Core technical skills you must have:**
----------------------------------------


* Strong commercial experience with **Node.js**, specifically **TypeScript**
* Experience with **Amazon Web Services**
* Experience with Serverless products
* Experience with document databases, ideally **MongoDB**
* Experience mentoring engineers
* Experience leading technical delivery in a build\-and\-run engineering model
* Experience in a structured on\-call process and incident management
* Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

**This role isn’t for you if...**
---------------------------------


* **You rely on a lot of top\-down direction.** Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve
* **You’re not comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.** Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet
* **You struggle to follow through on ideas.** We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen
* **You don’t like change**. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

**What’s in it for you…**
-------------------------


We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:


Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase


27 days holiday \+ bank holidays (some can be flexible) \+ day off on your birthday \+ three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave


Two volunteering days per year


Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years


✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance


Private medical insurance with AXA Health


Enhanced Parental leave


MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget


£750 per person learning budget


Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year


Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace


Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy


Perkbox – Flexi\-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts


Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

  


**Interview process**
---------------------


Interviewing is a two\-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:


* **Talent screen** \- **30 min** intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager
* **Bar raiser \- 40 min** with two Engineering leaders
* **Technical loop \- 2h** virtual technical assessment with 2 core components \- system design and TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.
* We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.


Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

  

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. **We’d love to hear from you!**

jobs.title: Senior Semiconductor Process Engineer (InP)
jobs.description:
Job Introduction
**Who We Are**


IQE is a leading global supplier of compound semiconductor wafers and advanced materials. As one of the only compound semiconductor epitaxy foundries with worldwide presence and scalable manufacturing, IQE drives technology growth. Our vision is to be the top provider of advanced semiconductor materials by delivering exceptional quality, service, and innovation, making us the first choice for customers. Our strength comes from our diverse, expert workforce and a culture built on integrity, accountability, excellence, teamwork, and valuing people.


At IQE, we are committed to reaching Net Zero and creating a sustainable future. We actively strive to reduce our carbon footprint, invest in green initiatives, and embed sustainability into everything we do. Join us in driving meaningful change and making a lasting impact on the environment.

 **About the role**


The Senior InP Process Engineer is responsible for knowledge of Semiconductor process and product interactions with efficient and reliable operation of Semiconductor epitaxial reactors (MOCVD, MBE), ensuring high product quality, production yield, and equipment uptime. This role mainly supports both Production activities, including process development, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.  



  

Main Responsibilities.

* Support for the operation and performance of Semiconductor reactors (MOCVD, MBE) to meet product specifications and output targets.
* Assists in generating growth and process recipes for production and calibration activities aligned with customer specs and engineering guidelines.
* Adjust process parameters to ensure product meets specifications.
* Monitor critical reactor parameters and material outputs for consistency and quality.
* Monitor and chart reactor performance using statistical process control (SPC) methods in compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Interpret process metrics and reactor health parameters.
* Support corrective/preventive actions, problem solving, failure analysis, process qualification, and root cause investigations with supervision.
* Coordinates reactor scheduling activities to meet production targets efficiently.
* Ensure Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software is managed to control Process Engineering activities, and accurately record all works carried out for traceability.
* Supports the creation of technical reports that are shared internally and externally with clarity using supporting data.
* Analyse data from the suite of characterisation tools internally along with external results to guide process control.
* Use computerized tools and software to follow process and routine tasks, accurately recording all works carried out for traceability and within the scope of the role.
* Have basic experience and competence with troubleshooting
* Perform other functions and duties as required.

 **About you**

* Professional attitude.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* Computer Literacy: Experience using Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
* Has a commitment to product and process quality.
* Attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and consistency.
* Has technical analytical skills.
* Supports continuous improvement of the processes and practices of Process Engineering.
* Good problem\-solving skills with an analytical mindset and ability to use data\-driven methods to support issues resolution.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, effective in shift handovers and reporting.
* Good understanding and knowledge of Semiconductor reactors (MOCVD, MBE) or other semiconductor growth technologies.

  

Experience Requirements:

* Comprehensive experience in Process Engineering or equivalent manufacturing field.
* 5\+ Years experience in Process Engineering or equivalent combination of education, experience and/or knowledge is desirable.
* Reactor (MOCVD, MBE) process knowledge preferred.
* Experience with SPC and recipe editing is preferred.
* Experience and knowledge of InP

Experience with reactor maintenance is a plus.  
* 

  

Qualification Requirements:

* Degree in a STEM related discipline and or relevant experience
* Specialised technical qualifications relevant to the role.

 **Why should you join us?**


All our employees benefit from:

* Long Term Incentive Plans (LTIPs)
* Professional Development and career pathways
* Discretionary Bonus plans
* Attractive pension plans
* Income Protection \- Permanent Health Insurance (PHI)
* Long Service Awards 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 years
* Values\-based recognition awards
* Health Cash Plan includes discounts with high street brands
* Cycle to work plan (includes E\-bikes)
* Electric Car Scheme (salary dependent)
* Employee Assistance Programme (Free family, legal, financial and counselling support 24/7 Access to second medical opinion and unlimited access to a remote GP)
* Life assurance 4x salary
* Access to workplace Mental Health First Aiders/wellbeing rooms

  

IQE is an equal opportunities employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

  

Want to learn more? Contact the Talent Acquisition team at TalentAcquisitionTeam@iqep.com or visit our website Current Vacancies \| IQE Corporate (iqep.com)

This is an excellent opportunity to lead the design, development, delivery and continuous improvement of software solutions across the Oxford Instruments Plasma Technology product portfolio while remaining actively involved in hands\-on software development.

  

Provide technical leadership throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring software systems are robust, maintainable, secure and aligned with business objectives. Mentor engineers, drive engineering best practices and act as a key technical authority for customers and internal stakeholders.

  

**What You'll Be Doing**


* Leading the design and development of software for our products and systems.
* Taking ownership of complex software projects and technical challenges from concept through delivery.
* Developing high\-quality software using technologies including C\#, C\+\+ and C.
* Working closely with multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Service, Product Management and Operations.
* Supporting customers and field service engineers in diagnosing and resolving challenging technical issues.
* Mentoring software engineers and helping establish best practices across the team.
* Reviewing software designs and implementations to ensure quality, maintainability and security.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Salary****: £45,000 to £55,000 per year, dependant on experience**  

**Location: Durham, Northallerton, Otley or Penrith, with hybrid working**  

**Contract: Permanent, Full\-Time, Monday to Friday**


Benefits: 25 days’ holiday, plus bank holidays, company pension and other benefits.


Are you an Electrical Building Services Engineer looking to take the next step in your career at Senior Level?


Due to our continued steady expansion, we now have the opportunity for a Senior Electrical Building Services Engineer to bring their experience, professionalism, and enthusiasm to the Building Services team at Align Property Services.


**What Our Team Has Been Working On**


Our Building Services team has recently delivered a series of rapid‑response mechanical and electrical projects for Durham County Council, supporting their drive toward net‑zero carbon and improved building performance. Working across a diverse estate of schools, leisure facilities, libraries, and community buildings, we’ve managed everything from early‑stage feasibility studies to major electrical and mechanical upgrades.


Through the NEPO Mechanical and Electrical Framework, the team successfully delivered ten projects, including schemes at Consett Branch Library, Coxhoe Active Life, Copeland Road Primary School, Shotton Primary Swimming Pool, Delves Lane Primary, Villa Real School, and Rookhope Primary. These projects involved integrating renewable and energy‑efficient technologies such as solar PV, air source heat pumps, low‑energy lighting, fire alarm upgrades, and modernised heating and electrical systems which were all completed with minimal disruption to essential services.


Every commission was delivered on time and to a high standard, improving building usability, reducing energy consumption, and directly supporting the council’s sustainability objectives. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape sustainable, impactful building services projects like these, we’d love to hear from you!


**What You’ll be Doing**


You will be responsible for providing a variety of services including those relating to building pathology, design, project management, building surveys and contract administration as well as producing early design advice through to detailed electrical services design. You'll have the opportunity to support and mentor our junior members of the team as they develop their skills and knowledge and look to you for your guidance.


As part of working on large projects, your day\-to\-day work will include:


* Electrical condition surveys
* Electrical design from concept to detail
* Project management and contract administration
* Providing early\-stage design advice and technical consultancy
* Managing complex workloads and promote collaboration across disciplines
* Deliver smart, cost\-effective solutions that meet client expectations.
* Offering advice on Health \& Safety, fire safety, and sustainability throughout the design and construction phases, ensuring compliance with CDM regulations and best practice standards.

**What we are looking for:**


* A degree or HNC in Building Services/Electrical Engineering
* Substantial experience in a senior engineering role
* A commitment to professional development, ideally working towards MCIBSE
* Confidence in conducting in electrical surveys, defect analysis, and feasibility reporting
* High\-quality electrical designs and documentation across RIBA stages
* A supportive leader to mentor colleagues while working collaboratively across disciplines
* Oversee site installations and ensure compliance with NEC/JCT contracts
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, NBS, and Microsoft Office
* A strong understanding of CDM regulations, fire safety, and sustainability principles
* A full UK driving licence and a willingness to travel across the area

For further information, please read the Job description


“Align your career success with delivering our ambitious growth plans”


When you join Align, you will join a team of professionals who feel rewarded for the work they do. Operating in a friendly and professional environment, we want to provide the training and resources to succeed and thrive in your role. Our people are not just numbers, everyone is crucial to the vital services we provide, and we treat everyone in our teams with respect and complete support.


**In return for your commitment, we offer:**


* A Competitive salary up to £55,000 per year, dependent on your skills and experience
* Enrolment on to a company pension scheme which we will contribute up to 6%
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays with opportunity to purchase up to 10 additional annual leave days per leave year.
* Hybrid working to support you in a healthy work\-life balance.
* Professional development through varying project work

A benefits scheme which includes a good maternity leave package, cycle2work scheme and our online voucher portal giving access to discounts from leading retailers to help you* on shopping, days out, or nights in.
* Stability in your role \- public sector security in a private sector industry

**How to Apply**


To apply, please complete the short application form and attach your CV. If you have any questions please contact our Recruitment and Talent Partner Devon Lowe on devon.lowe@northyorks.gov.uk or 07720869014\.


The deadline for applications is Midnight on **Sunday 25th October 2026\.**


*Interviews are planned to take place throughout the recruitment process, if you would like to apply, please do so now and we will respond to you quickly. We reserve the right to remove this vacancy in the event of the position being filled before the proposed deadline.*


  
Senior Electrical Engineer
Salary: £45000 \- 55000
Posted: 29/09/2026
Closing date: 25/10/2026
Closing time: 23:59 (GMT)

* Providing test estimates

* Delivered front end cross\-browser functional testing, device testing, exploratory, systems integration and user acceptance testing e.g. manual testing.
* Confident with building and maintaining frameworks in one or more of these languages: Java, JavaScript, Python, or C\#.

**Location**
------------


Bristol, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Telford, Worthing
**About the job**
-----------------


### **Job summary**


Discover a career in your hands at HMRC. Whether you're seeking purpose, growth, or a workplace that gives you a true sense of belonging, hear from some of our employees as they share their story about what its really like to work at HMRC.

  

Visit our YouTube channel to watch the full series and come and discover your potential.


HMRC is made up of Customer Groups which are working independently towards one common goal. Our role sits within HMRCs Chief Digital \& Information Office (CDIO) Group that deliver in\-house solutions for a broad range of technical and operational issues. Our digital delivery centres are hi\-tech, state\-of\-the\-art facilities that allow our teams to maximise their capabilities.
  

  

CDIO values and empowers the growth of its people and offers the CDIO University. This is a one stop shop for all things learning and development. The comprehensive offer encompassing academic, personal and career related opportunity and learning, ensuring all receive a consistent approach to technical learning. This includes access to subject matter experts, technical learning, professional communities, academies, apprenticeships, talent schemes as well as providing, delivering, encouraging and supporting activities for personal growth and wellbeing.


### **Job description**


As a member of the Quality Assurance and Testing (QAT) Profession, you will be part of a large community of testing professionals working collaboratively with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, Business Analysts and Operations teams to deliver high\-quality, resilient and scalable digital services for HMRC customers.
  

  

We have an inclusive environment and have clear pathways in place to support and build on the roles within the Profession through the use of learning journeys, learning platforms, career journeys and skills assessments. These all work together to allow you to take ownership of your own development and career progression with HMRC as well as supporting you in your daily challenges. Along with this we also have an Academy in place to allow you to find everything to support your needs in an easily accessible format.
  

  

As a Senior Test Engineer within CDIO, Borders \& Trade, You will be responsible for building and enhancing Performance and Non\-Functional Testing capability across cloud\-based applications, platforms and infrastructure. You will primarily lead the delivery of Performance and Volume Testing (PVT), whilst contributing to Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Infrastructure Assurance, Resilience and Operational Readiness activities, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable and fit for live service operation.
  

  

A Senior Test engineer has similar responsibilities to a test engineer but at a more complex level and on a greater scale. At this role level, you will:  

  

  



Lead the planning, design, execution and reporting of Performance \& Volume Testing (PVT), including workload modelling, capacity planning and performance analysis, whilst supporting OAT, infrastructure, resilience and operational readiness testing activities where required.  

* 
Define non\-functional requirements, workload models, acceptance criteria, test strategies and environment validation approaches to identify and mitigate risks early in the delivery lifecycle.  
* 
Analyse test results, infrastructure behaviour and operational metrics to identify bottlenecks, defects, root causes and service risks, providing evidence\-based recommendations for improvement.  
* 
Develop and maintain automated performance testing and validation solutions using tools, scripting languages and CI/CD pipelines to support shift\-left quality engineering practices.  
* 
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring and knowledge sharing across the QAT Profession, supporting continuous improvement of PVT, OAT and infrastructure testing capability within Borders \& Trade.
### **Person specification**


As a Senior Test Engineer within CDIO Borders and Trade, you will primarily lead and deliver Performance and Volume Testing activities across applications, platforms and cloud infrastructure, whilst providing support and assurance for Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Infrastructure and Operational Readiness activities.  

  

  



* Develop and maintain Performance and Volume Test artefacts, including strategies, workload models, plans, scenarios, test data requirements, evidence packs and reports, whilst supporting OAT and Infrastructure testing artefacts where required.
Review requirements, architecture designs, infrastructure specifications and operational designs to define appropriate non\-functional test coverage and acceptance criteria.  
* 
Provide estimates, plans, risk assessments and technical advice for projects requiring PVT, OAT, infrastructure assurance or platform validation services.  
* 
Deliver and support performance, volume, resilience, failover, disaster recovery, infrastructure and operational readiness testing across complex enterprise environments.  
* 
Investigate defects, incidents and live\-service issues through root cause analysis, working with engineering, operations and supplier teams to support resolution.  
* 
* Promote automation, quality engineering, knowledge sharing and mentoring to grow the Non\-Functional Testing capability.

**Essential Criteria**


The successful candidate will need to demonstrate practical knowledge and experience in the following:  

  

  



Proven experience leading and delivering Performance and Volume Testing across complex enterprise environments, with awareness and practical exposure to Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), Infrastructure, Resilience, Availability and Disaster Recovery testing.  

* 
Experience defining non\-functional test strategies, scope, objectives, workload models, acceptance criteria, test plans and test data requirements, ensuring solutions meet performance, scalability, resilience, availability and operational support requirements.  
* 
Experience planning, executing, analysing and reporting Performance and Volume Testing activities, including load, stress, endurance, scalability, resilience, failover and recovery testing, with the ability to identify bottlenecks, root causes and service risks.  
* 
Experience developing and implementing automated testing and validation solutions using tools such as JMeter, Jenkins and GitLab, supported by scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java or C\#, and integrated into CI/CD pipelines.  
* 
Experience using and validating observability and monitoring platforms such as AppDynamics, ELK, Grafana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Kafka or equivalent tools, alongside operating system, infrastructure and database monitoring capabilities.  
* 
Knowledge of Operational Acceptance Testing (OAT), including operational readiness, monitoring, alerting, logging, support procedures, operational runbooks, failover, backup and recovery, and live service support.  
* 
Knowledge of cloud and infrastructure technologies, including AWS/Azure, Linux/RHEL, networking, DNS, load balancing, IAM, security controls, distributed architectures and containerised platforms.  
* 
* Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings and risks effectively, influence delivery decisions, and support Agile, DevOps and continuous improvement practices.

**Desirable Criteria**


Ideally, the successful candidate will also demonstrate knowledge and experience in the following:


ISTQB Foundation (or equivalent) and/or relevant Performance Testing, Cloud, Infrastructure, DevOps or Automation certifications.  

* 
Experience testing cloud\-native and containerised solutions using technologies such as AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.  
* 
Experience implementing shift\-left quality engineering practices, including automated non\-functional testing within CI/CD pipelines.  
* 
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management and modern DevOps practices.  
* 
* Experience supporting resilience, failover, high availability and disaster recovery testing activities across cloud and enterprise platforms.

**Further Location Information**


Please ensure that you only apply for a location that you are willing and able to work from, as we will only make one offer of employment. Any additional notes included in a Further Location Preferences (optional) field within the application form, will not be considered. Please be aware that you cannot change your location preference after submitting your application.


**Office Closures**


If your location preference is for the following site, its important to note that this is not long\-term site for HMRC and we will require you to move to a new building in the future, subject to our location strategy and the applicable employee policies at that time.


For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations


This site is:


* Telford Plaza, Telford \- moving to Parkside Court, Telford

You will be given more information about what this means at the job offer stage.


**Leeds Location**


Moves Adjustment Payment will be available for this role, provided the successful applicant is a current HMRC colleague in Bradford and meets the eligibility requirements outlined in the HMRCs Moves Adjustment Payment guidance.


**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £45,544, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £13,194 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
HMRC operates both Flexible and Hybrid Working policies, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments. We welcome applications from those who need to work a more flexible arrangement and will agree to requests where possible, considering our operational and customer service needs.


We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.


* Pension \- We make contributions to our colleagues Alpha pension equal to at least 28\.97% of their salary.
* Family friendly policies.
* Personal support.
* Coaching and development.

To find out more about HMRC benefits and find out what its really like to work for HMRChear from our insiders or visit Thinking of joining the Civil Service


**Things you need to know**
---------------------------


### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.
### **Selection process details**


**How to Apply**


As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:


A name\-blind CV including your job history and relevant experience. Please provide a brief overview of your responsibilities, contributions, and any key achievements in each role. As a guide, we would expect this section to be around 500 words in total.  

* 
A 750\-word Personal Statement. Your Personal Statement should clearly demonstrate how your skills and experiences meet the essential criteria.  
* 

Please evidence any Desirable Criteria where applicable (up to 250 words max). This is not essential for the role but may be considered by the vacancy holder where candidates have the same score at interview.


Further details around what this will entail are listed on the application form.


**Sift**


In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held on your CV.


At full sift your CV and Personal Statement will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.


We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.


**Interview**


During the panel interview, your experience will be assessed, to determine your suitability for the role.


Interviews will take place via video link. Sift and interview dates to be confirmed.


Please note that circumstances may arise that require the planned interview format to change. We will endeavour to provide you with as much notice of any change as possible.


**Eligibility**


Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form. Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday\-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you. If you do make a mistake with your eligibility form, or have withdrawn yourself in error and need your application reinstated whilst the campaign is still live, please contact us via: unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk  Use the subject line to insert appropriate wording for example  Please re\-open my application  **\[insert vacancy ref]** \& vacancy closing date **\[insert date].**


To check that you are eligible to apply for this role, please review the eligibility information before submitting your application.


Exceptionally, candidates who are not successful at this grade may be considered for appointment to similar roles at a lower grade where the eligibility criteria are met. If this applies, we will contact you directly.


**Sponsorship**

We have assessed this role against both Home Office and HMRC criteria and we are unable to offer sponsorship for a Skilled Worker Visa. This means the vacancy is not open to applicants who require visa sponsorship.


**The HMRC app can help you with your application**


The HMRC app can provide you with your past 5 years' employment history, making the process of filling in your application quicker and easier.


If successful in your application, you will need your National Insurance number for the onboarding process.


Download the HMRC app now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.
  

  

**How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account**

Download the free HMRC app from the App Store or Google Play store.


If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.


Youll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6\-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.


You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK: Technical support with HMRC online services.


**Reserve List**


A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles  if this applies to you, well let you know via your Civil Service Jobs account.


**Merit List**


After interview, a single merit list will be created, and you will only be considered for posts in locations you have expressed a preference for. Appointments will be made in strict merit order in line with the set number of roles in each location.


**Criminal Record Check**

**Hybrid working at HMRC**
