**About the job**
-----------------


### **Job summary**


We are currently looking for a **Senior Developer (SQ Web)** to join our **Technology and Service Operations** Function within the **Digital and Technology Group**.


This is a **full\-time** opportunity, on a **permanent** basis. The role will be based in 7/8 Wellington Place, Leeds, LS1 4AP.


Government departments and agencies are working towards implementing a minimum 60% attendance in office sites.

  

We are currently implementing a flexible, hybrid way of working, with a minimum of 8 days per month working on site to enable the collaboration and contact with partners and stakeholders needed to deliver MHRA business. Attendance on site is driven by business needs so depending on the nature of the role, this can flex up to 12 days a month, with the remainder of time worked either remotely or in the office. Some roles will need to be on site more regularly. Remote working is potentially available for some specific roles. Please discuss this with the recruiting manager before accepting an appointment.

  

### **Job description**


**Who are we?**


The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.


The MHRA Digital and Technology Group (DTG) exists to help protect and improve public health by enabling the Agency to become a modern, intelligence\-led regulator.


We bring together digital, data, technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence expertise to deliver services, platforms and insights that support the regulation of medicines, medical devices and healthcare technologies across the UK.


Our work goes beyond traditional IT. We design and deliver user\-centred services, harness trusted data, apply advanced analytics and responsible AI, and build secure, resilient digital foundations that help the MHRA make better decisions, work more effectively and respond to a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.


By joining DTG, you'll help shape the future of regulation while delivering technology that makes a real difference to public health.


The Technology \& Service Operations (TSO) function is responsible for managing the existing IT infrastructure including both software and hardware, databases, and other technology platforms; leading the support and maintenance of applications; development and testing of new applications and platforms; and cyber and information security for the Agency.


The Engineering team, made up of software developers, DevOps engineers, Quality Assurance testers, and data professionals (including engineers, scientists, and visualization experts), is tasked with the creation of applications and services, ensuring quality for both new and existing agency offerings, and developing data visualizations through their expertise in data engineering and science.


### **Person specification**


**Role Purpose**


This Senior Developer role implements web applications and guides the ways in which the team works and provide technical leadership, to deliver cloud native web\-based solutions to our end users. The post holder will be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written and will contribute to the developer community and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice.


The post holder will work in cross\-functional product squads on the design and development of creating cloud native (Azure), JavaScript based microservices (node.js) and front end (react) utilising agile (SAFe), paired programming, TDD and DevOps.

  

**Key responsibilities and results areas**


* As an experienced voice in the technical team, you will steer implementation and code design decisions for contingent labour and service providers
* Mentoring more junior members of your team to develop and maintain high\-performance, scalable solutions
* Assist in leading the design and development of site/software projects following best practices, as well as regular status reporting
* Assist in leading in optimising, debugging, and enhancing existing software whilst preventing regression in live systems
* You must have solid JavaScript coding skills, experience of TDD/BDD (jest, enzyme, cucumber, gherkin), be collaborative (Jira, Confluence, GitHub)
* You will establish good engineering practices and have strong ability with Open Source, Cloud First, Microservices and DevOps principles and its associated technology like React, Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Azure services (AKS, CosmosDB, Blob Storage, Functions), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to a collaborative, dynamic planning process \- prioritising the work that needs to be done against the capacity and capability of the team ensuring the smooth and successful development of sites/software.
  

  

### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Developing Self and Others
* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
* Communicating and Influencing

We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:


* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* You will hold a Computer Science or similar engineering degree, ideally hold a post\-graduate qualification, or equivalent industry experience.
* You will ideally hold certifications with a major cloud provider (preferably in Azure) and as a microservice based full stack JavaScript developer.
* You will have previous experience as a developer working in a DDaT environment working on workstreams specific to the regulation of medicines/devices data and its subsequent caseworking.
* Substantial experience with certain tools and associated engineering processes.
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £42,410, Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency contributes £12,286 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
* Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave on entry, rising by one day for each completed year of service to a maximum of 30 days and pro\-rata for part\-time staff. PLUS 8 bank holidays
* Privilege Leave: 1 day
* Hours of Work: 37 hours (net) per week for full time staff in all geographical locations, including London and pro rata for part\-time staff
* Occupational Sick Pay (OSP): One month full pay/one month half pay on entry, rising by one month for each completed year of service to a maximum of six months full pay and six months half pay after five years service.
* Mobility: Mobility clause in contracts allowing staff to be mobile across the Civil Service
* Civil Service Pension Scheme. Please see the link for further information http://www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk/ For enquiries relating to the Civil Service Pension Schemes please contact MyCSP's Pension Service Centre directly on 0300 123 6666
* Flexible working to ensure staff maintain a healthy work\-life balance
* Interest free season ticket loan or bike loan
* Employee Assistance Services and access to the Civil Service Benevolent Fund
* Eligibility to join Motoring , Boundless by CSMA
* Variety of staff and Civil Service clubs
* On\-going learning and development
  

  

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------


### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.
### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths, Experience and Technical skills.
**Key dates** (dates are indicative only and could be subject to change)


* Closing date  11 October 2026 at 23:55
* Sifting  from 16 October 2026
* Main panel interviews  from 26 October 2026

Communications will be electronic via email therefore it is important that you check your Civil Service Jobs account regularly, as well as your spam/junk email folder.


Were committed to being diverse and inclusive, so please make your application anonymous by removing all identifying personal information (such as names and dates) from your employment history and personal statement.


**What will the process look like?**


**1\. Sift Stage**


The main sift, where we'll read and score the rest of your application. This may involve a large number of applications, please bear with us as this can take some time.


* **Anonymised CV** which sets out your career history, previous experience and skills, highlighting specific responsibilities that are relevant for this role.

In your personal statement we are looking for evidence of how you meet the role criteria and person specification. At Focus Group, we're looking for a talented and passionate **PHP Developer** to join our Technology team on a 12\-month fixed\-term contract. jobs.title: Software Engineering (Graduate & Internship Opportunites)
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Alloyed is a young venture\-funded company of about 300 world\-class metallurgists, engineers, and software developers working across the UK, Japan and the US to build the future of advanced metal components and systems. To do this, Alloyed uses proprietary software packages which combine advanced machine learning and physical modelling to invent better alloys, devise better ways to process them, and design better 3D\-printed components and assemblies.


Alloyed is composed of a range of divisions, enabling metal technology from composition to systems:

* **Core Technology:** Alloyed's internal research and technology hub, focused on creating the new alloys, manufacturing methods, digital tools and intellectual property that will power the company's future products and capabilities.
* **Innovation Services:** Work directly with customers to develop, optimise and qualify materials and manufacturing processes for demanding aerospace, defence, energy and industrial applications.
* **Component Engineering:** Design, manufacture and validate production\-ready components, turning material and process innovations into high\-performance hardware for customer applications.
* **Argive:** Develop and manufacture complete microturbine engine systems under ambitious timelines and customer expectations, enabled by Alloyed’s software stack, proprietary Alloys and AM processing capabilities.


Whether you're a recent graduate or a current university student, we offer exciting opportunities to gain real\-world engineering experience at Alloyed.

* **Graduate Engineers**: Full\-time positions for graduates ready to launch their careers on or before September 2027\.
* **Summer Internships**: 8\-week placements for students looking to apply their learning in an industry environment starting in July 2027\.

**Role Overview**


We're looking for bright, curious candidates to join Alloyed's Software Engineering team. We like solving difficult problems and building software properly before rounding off the day with a little table tennis.


You'll work on production software at the intersection of cloud technology, data and advanced manufacturing. Our platforms support engineers throughout the product lifecycle, from design and process development to manufacturing, inspection and qualification.


No two weeks are the same. You might create a new web application, build a .NET service, work with SQL databases or design an API. You'll gain hands\-on experience with modern software development practices, including automated testing, code review, containerised applications, CI/CD and cloud deployment.


You'll work closely with software engineers, materials scientists and process engineers to build real products from week one. That could mean understanding a user problem, designing and building a new feature, testing it with engineers, or supporting its release into production.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, deploy and maintain Alloyed’s software platforms for: Data management / Traceability / Visualisation and analysis / Process optimisation
* Work within a fast\-paced, agile development team alongside software engineers, process engineers, technicians and materials scientists.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user requirements and generating user stories through to development, testing and release.
* Work collaboratively to solve complex technical and engineering problems.
* Translate specialised engineering knowledge and workflows into intuitive, reliable software.
* Integrate machine\-learning models into production software for performance prediction and process optimisation.
* Contribute to the ongoing improvement of our software architecture, development practices and engineering standards.

**Essential skills**

* A strong technical background, demonstrated through a completed or expected degree in a quantitative subject such as computer science, engineering, mathematics or the physical sciences (2:1 minimum).
* Experience writing software in at least one object\-oriented programming language through academic, personal or professional projects, for example C\#, C\+\+, Java, Python or Go.
* An interest in applied engineering or science.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
* Experience with version control systems, such as Git.
* Understanding of data structures and algorithms.
**Desired skills**

* Good understanding of software design patterns, best practices and principles, e.g. DRY.
* Familiarity with test\-driven development.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of concurrent programming principles.
* Experience programming with 3D geometry.
* Experience developing or integrating machine\-learning models.

**Technology Stack:**

* Backend: C\# \| C\+\+ \| ASP.NET Core \| EF Core \| GraphQL \| REST
* Frontend: Blazor \| Next.js \| React \| TypeScript
* Data: Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure \| Azure DevOps \| Docker
* AI: Azure AI Foundry

jobs.title: Engineering Operations Coordinator – Maternity Leave Cover
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Humanscale is the premier designer and manufacturer of ergonomic products that improve health and comfort at work. **We have a focus on sustainability with over 70% of our products currently certified as having a Net Positive impact on the environment.** Our award\-winning office products – seating, sit/stand desks, technology support and lighting – have led the industry in performance and simplicity for over 40 years.
Overview:

This is temporary cover / fixed\-term contract role to cover maternity leave.  

The role of UK Engineering Operations Coordinator is an administration position whose main role is to organise and assist the Engineers in the department to have the correct parts and information to carry out their customer visits.  

Second to this is dealing directly with our customers and Dealer partners from a customer support point of view. Making sure they are happy with their Humanscale products and if not to assist them with replacement parts orders or booking in our engineers to carry out any repairs.
Responsibilities:
* Manage and coordinate the UK Support mailbox, ensuring all enquiries are handled efficiently and prioritised appropriately.
* Provide timely, professional, and high\-quality customer service, responding to client and customer enquiries promptly.
* Generate quotations based on engineering audit reports.
* Generate quotations based on customers repair and warranty enquiries.
* Submit customer, warranty, and warehouse stock orders to the Dublin Customer Service team.
* Create and manage defect reports for quality issues relating to Humanscale products.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Humanscale furniture dealers, partners, and key accounts.
* Maintain the UK Support engineering repair log, ensuring daily repair jobs are accurately recorded and tracked.
* Prepare and issue weekly customer invoices for completed chargeable work, while proactively supporting initiatives to improve financial performance and reduce outstanding balances.
* Schedule and coordinate engineers’ visits, ensuring all work is planned, communicated, and executed efficiently for customers and the engineering team.
* Provide operational support to the Sales team, advising on warranty claims and engineering\-related enquiries.
* Promote effective teamwork within the department, ensuring deadlines are achieved and operational processes run efficiently.
* Support projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring milestones, deadlines, and customer satisfaction objectives are consistently met.
* Attend regular operational, progress, and management meetings to provide updates and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary point of contact for operational matters, resolving issues effectively and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day business operations.


Qualifications:
* Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent prioritization and time\-management skills.
* Professional and confident communication with customers, dealers, partners and key accounts.
* High attention to detail is a must
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, complex environment
* Experience of Microsoft Office including Excel and prior experience of internal order management systems is an advantage

 **Humanscale is an equal opportunities employer**
Please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.humanscale.com/about/legal\-information/privacy\-policy.cfm

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer (Azure) - Cardiff
jobs.description:
**Internal Information**
------------------------

Location: Cardiff


Grade: C1/C2


SC Clearance Eligibility required


**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------

You will design, build and ship agentic AI applications on Microsoft Azure for clients in regulated and high\-governance sectors. This is a hands\-on engineering role in a product\-aligned team: you will take a solution from first design through to live production, and then keep it running.  



We work across Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport, Health and the Public Sector, so you will pick up new domains quickly and often.  



* A multi\-agent case\-handling assistant for a public sector client, retrieving from several legacy systems of record, with full audit trails and human\-in\-the\-loop approval on every outbound decision.
* A document\-intelligence pipeline for a utilities client that extracts structured data from tens of thousands of scanned engineering records, with automated groundedness and accuracy evaluation gating each release.
* An internal developer platform capability that lets a retail client's own engineers deploy evaluated, guardrailed agents against their product data without going through us each time.
**Your Role**
-------------

Delivery and technical leadership


* Act as a trusted technical voice for architects, product owners and client stakeholders, turning business problems into agentic AI solution designs.
* Own solutions across the full lifecycle, from design through to production support.
* Explain technical trade\-offs and AI risk and value clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Reflect compliance and audit requirements in technical delivery decisions when working in regulated client environments.
Mentor and pair with less experienced colleagues.  
* 
Engineering


* Build and deploy agentic AI applications and multi\-agent systems on Azure using Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry) and the Azure AI Services portfolio, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence.
* Develop production\-grade AI\-enabled services and APIs in Python and C\#/.NET, integrating agents and models with enterprise applications and data sources.
* Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation and agent orchestration patterns to build reliable, tool\-using workflows.
* Implement guardrails, content safety, evaluation, monitoring and governance for generative and agentic solutions.
* Integrate with Azure\-native services (Functions, Container Apps, AKS, API Management) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Support LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation, deployment pipelines and observability for AI workloads in production.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------

* Production experience building LLM\-based applications on Azure that went live and that you then supported, rather than proofs of concept that stopped at demo.
* Strong production coding in Python and/or C\#/.NET, including building and integrating APIs and backend services.
* Practical depth in retrieval\-augmented generation: chunking and embedding strategy, retrieval tuning, and evaluating the groundedness and accuracy of outputs in a live system.
Client\-facing delivery experience, comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and able to explain technical trade\-offs to people who are not engineers.  
* 

We use all of the following. You are not expected to arrive with them, and where you do not have them we will help you develop them.


* Breadth across agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen) so you can make an informed call on which fits a use case rather than defaulting to the one you know.
* Judgement on the model landscape: selecting between proprietary and open\-weight models on cost, latency and quality, and revisiting that as the landscape shifts.
* Multi\-agent systems and tool\-calling and function\-calling patterns.
* Containerisation and orchestration for AI workloads at scale (Docker, AKS).
* Vector search at scale (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector search).
* LLMOps and MLOps tooling and automated evaluation harnesses.
* Data privacy, security and compliance for AI systems, including responsible AI standards and GDPR considerations.
* Delivery in regulated and high\-governance environments.
**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2\) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
  

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


* Declare they have a disability, and


* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.


**Your security clearance and pre\-employment checks**
------------------------------------------------------

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance .


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


**Make it real – what does it mean for you?**
---------------------------------------------

We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud.

  

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024\. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
  

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

  

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.


**Why you should consider Capgemini**
-------------------------------------

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. We work across Retail, Utilities, Manufacturing, Transport, Health and the Public Sector, so you will pick up new domains quickly and often.  



Examples of what you will actually be building


* Application modernisation/re\-platforming a utilities client's billing integration layer from a monolith onto event\-driven .NET microservices on AKS, with no customer\-facing downtime during cutover.
* Designing and running the API platform behind a public sector service handling several million transactions a month, including the service\-level objectives, observability and incident process that go with it.
* Building the internal developer platform and deployment pipelines a retail client's own engineering teams use day to day, so they can release safely without a hand\-off to us.
**Your Role**
-------------

Delivery and technical leadership


* Act as an engineer and subject matter expert on client delivery engagements, owning specification, development, testing and implementation of complex cloud native applications on Azure.
* Lead and mentor development teams and raise the engineering standard around you.
* Shape delivery practice across projects: branching strategy, testing approach, CI/CD and release pipelines.
Engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders on the client side.  
* 
Engineering


* Design and document Azure cloud native solutions, incorporating recommended security practices, and contribute to architectural decisions.
* Build resilient, scalable APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and contribute to integration\-led transformations and platforms.
* Containerise workloads with Docker and orchestrate with Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Define and automate infrastructure as code using Bicep or Terraform, and build out CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.

* Keep services healthy once live: availability, latency, errors, saturation and traffic, instrumented with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry and Log Analytics.
* Apply secure cloud native design principles: identity\-first, encryption, least privilege and zero trust.
* Scale systems sustainably through automation, and reduce toil rather than absorbing it.

------------------------------

* Strong production .NET engineering (C\#, .NET 8 or later), with a working command of SOLID, software design patterns and test\-driven development.

* Containerisation and orchestration in production with Docker and Kubernetes, ideally AKS.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Digital)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

  

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth \& Investments group.

  

Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.

  

Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.

  

We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.

  

Aberdeen comprises three businesses, interactive investor (ii), Investments, and Adviser, each of which focuses on meeting and adapting to our clients’ evolving needs:

  

* interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct\-to\-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.
* Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.
* Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.

 **About the Department**


The Digital Engineering team designs, builds and evolves the digital platforms that power Aberdeen’s public websites and digital services. Working closely with Product Owners, Architects, UX specialists and business stakeholders, the team delivers secure, scalable and client\-focused solutions that support Aberdeen’s strategic ambitions. Collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence are central to how the team works, helping to enable our clients to be better investors.

 **About the Role**


As a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer (Digital), you will play a leading role in building and enhancing modern digital platforms using React, Next.js, .NET and Microsoft Azure. You will work across front\-end applications, backend services, cloud infrastructure and enterprise integrations, contributing to technical design, architecture and engineering standards while remaining hands\-on in delivery. This is an opportunity to influence technology modernisation, mentor fellow engineers and improve digital experiences used by clients and customers. Based in Edinburgh, you will help drive innovation, resilience and operational excellence while continuing to develop your own expertise and career.  



  

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain modern web applications, APIs and digital integrations that deliver secure, scalable and high\-performing client experiences.
* Lead technical design decisions, influence architecture and ensure alignment with engineering, security and accessibility standards.
* Drive cloud\-native development within Microsoft Azure, including CI/CD automation, observability and operational excellence.
* Collaborate across product, UX, architecture and business teams to deliver high\-quality digital solutions and technology modernisation initiatives.
* Investigate complex production issues, lead root cause analysis and continuously improve platform resilience and service performance.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering capability, reusable platform services and cross\-team improvement initiatives.

 **About the Candidate**

* Strong proficiency in React and Next.js for modern web application development.
* Experience building and supporting REST APIs and backend services using C\# and .NET.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud\-native services and identity integrations.
* Knowledge of Git, GitHub Actions, automation tooling and modern software delivery practices.
* Strong understanding of accessibility, SEO, security, performance optimisation and SQL.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving and mentoring skills with a collaborative mindset.

 **Desirable criteria**: Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, Sitecore XM Cloud, Vercel, Playwright, Storybook, GraphQL, Marketing Cloud, Aprimo, Seismic, Sitecore Search, CodeQL, SonarQube and experience of enterprise\-scale digital platforms.

  

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

 **Our benefits**

  

There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.


When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance\-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here.

 **Our business**

  

Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here.

 **An inclusive way of working**

  

Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.


At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.

  

An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

**We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment. We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance. We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Fintech/ Crypto
jobs.description:
**Hey! Nice to see you!**


At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started to build a company that attracts great minds and enables us to achieve great things while genuinely enjoying what we do. Our mission is to support tech companies and startups (scaleups) in scaling their teams quickly and with high quality, while boosting product development, testing, and deployment so we can succeed together.


We are currently working with a French company that is a leader in security and infrastructure solutions for cryptocurrencies and blockchain applications. It has a team of more than 400 professionals developing a variety of products and services to safeguard cryptocurrency assets, including worldwide leading hardware wallets.


As a **Platform Engineer,** you will work closely with product engineering teams to improve the developer experience and remove friction from the build, package, and deployment process. You will own and improve developer tooling, self\-service platforms, golden paths, runners, registries, delivery tooling, and observability. You will collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the platform is fast, reliable, secure, and easy to use, while using automation and strong systems thinking to help teams ship faster and more safely.
  

  

**Your daily responsibilities**


**CI/CD platform \& runner fleet**


* Own and evolve the self\-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet, including Linux runners managed via Actions Runner Controller (ARC), self\-hosted macOS runners, and the Terraform modules that provision and scale self\-hosted infrastructure.
* Right\-size runner classes (CPU/memory/storage) against real workload profiles, balancing cost efficiency against engineering velocity, and supporting engineering teams in understanding and owning the resource footprint of their own jobs.
* Support the migration away from GitHub\-hosted runners, including evaluating trade\-offs between containerised and VM\-based execution for workloads with special hardware requirements (e.g. KVM access for Android emulators).
* Partner with embedded DevOps engineers on pipeline and dependency\-graph optimisations (build triggers, job fan\-out, monorepo change detection) to reduce queue times and unnecessary CI spend — you own the platform and runner layer these pipelines execute on.
* Investigate and resolve macOS virtualisation performance issues (e.g. Tart) and help evaluate alternative approaches such as remote simulator hosts.

**Artifact \& package management**


* Administer the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, Curation) as the organization’s primary artifact
  

repository, including repository structure, access control, vulnerability scanning policies, and
  

curation/allow\-listing of upstream dependencies.
* Provide light\-touch, minimal support for GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) and GitHub Packages where teams use them alongside JFrog.
* Operate and maintain ChartMuseum as the organization’s Helm chart repository, hosted on S3,
  

including storage lifecycle, access, and chart promotion workflows.
* Define and enforce container image ownership boundaries — platform\-owned hardened/minimal base images (e.g. Docker Hardened Images, Chainguard) versus engineering\-owned project extensions — and drive Dockerfile build and layer optimisation best practices across teams.

**Progressive delivery \& infrastructure automation**


* Operate two ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts environments, one serving internal tooling and one serving product workloads supporting GitOps\-based, progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) patterns for engineering teams.
* Author, maintain, and support Helm charts and Kustomize overlays as the standard configuration management approach for Kubernetes workloads, providing golden\-path templates that reduce boilerplate for product teams.
* Design, review, and evolve Terraform and Terragrunt modules for infrastructure\-as\-code, including maintaining a public/internal module registry that product and platform teams can consume in a self\-service manner.

**Observability \& reliability**


* Improve and help unify the observability stack; Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager. Fixing
  

metric accuracy issues, building meaningful dashboards, and defining SLOs/alerting that reflect real platform and pipeline health.
* Work across Datadog and VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics to reduce tool sprawl, and help define a
  

coherent strategy for where metrics, logs, and events should live.
* Provide platform\-level telemetry (runner utilization, build queue times, artifact scan results, deployment health) that gives engineering teams and leadership a single, trustworthy view of pipeline and platform performance.

**Internal developer platform, policy \& modern workloads**


* Evaluate and help operate Crossplane as a control\-plane layer for self\-service, Kubernetes\-native infrastructure provisioning, complementing the existing Terraform/Terragrunt IaC estate.
* Contribute to a developer portal / internal catalogue strategy (e.g. Backstage, Cortex, or Port) so engineers have a single place to discover services, ownership, docs, and golden\-path templates.
* Implement and maintain policy\-as\-code guardrails using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA) across the Kubernetes and CI/CD estate (e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines).
* Support Knative\-based serverless/event\-driven workloads on Kubernetes where teams need
  

scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven compute.
* Roll out OpenTelemetry instrumentation and pipelines to standardise traces, metrics, and logs across services, feeding the Grafana/Prometheus/Datadog/VictoriaLogs stack with consistent, correlated telemetry.

**Developer experience \& enablement**


* Act as the platform’s embedded point of contact for one or more product engineering teams:
  

Understand their day\-to\-day friction, prioritise platform work accordingly, and close the loop on
  

delivery.
* Build self\-service tooling, templates, and documentation (golden paths) so engineers can provision runners, publish artifacts, and deploy without needing deep platform expertise.
* Clearly document ownership boundaries between platform and product teams (e.g. base images vs. application extensions) and help engineering teams operate confidently within them.
* Contribute to the platform roadmap, bringing a developer\-experience lens to prioritisation — and measure success in terms of engineer\-facing outcomes such as build time, queue time, and self\-service adoption, not just infrastructure uptime.

**We need you to have**


**Experience \& technical skills**


* 5\+ years in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, ideally
  

supporting product engineering teams directly.
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runner architectures (Actions Runner Controller / Kubernetes\-based Linux runners, self\-hosted macOS runners) and provisioning them via Terraform.
* Practical knowledge of the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, and ideally Curation) for artifact
  

management and dependency security.
* Familiarity with container registries beyond a single vendor (GHCR/GitHub Packages) and Helm chart repositories such as ChartMuseum on object storage (S3\).
* Experience with GitOps continuous delivery using ArgoCD, and ideally Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) across multiple clusters/environments.
* Strong Kubernetes configuration management skills with Helm and Kustomize.
* Solid Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform and Terragrunt, including designing and
  

consuming shared/reusable modules.
* Experience with Crossplane (or a comparable Kubernetes\-native control\-plane approach) for building self\-service infrastructure APIs, alongside deep Terraform proficiency for the underlying IaC.
* Experience building or operating an internal developer portal/software catalogue such as Backstage, Cortex, or Port, including modelling service ownership and scorecards.
* Hands\-on experience with policy\-as\-code enforcement in Kubernetes using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA / Gatekeeper) — e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines.
* Familiarity with Knative or similar Kubernetes\-native serverless/eventing frameworks for scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven workloads.
* Experience building, hardening, and optimizing container images (Dockerfile best practices,
  

minimal/hardened base images such as Docker Hardened Images or Chainguard).
* Working knowledge of an observability stack — Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager — plus exposure to Datadog and/or VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics, and practical experience instrumenting services and pipelines with OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics, logs).
* Comfortable in Linux/Unix environments, with solid scripting ability (e.g. Bash, Python, or Go) and strong Git fundamentals.
* AWS cloud experience (compute, storage/S3, networking fundamentals) is a plus.

**Soft skills**


* Genuine product mindset toward internal platforms: you think in terms of the engineer as a customer, and you seek out and act on their feedback.
* Strong cross\-functional collaborator, comfortable embedding with a product engineering team and building trust with people who don’t share your infrastructure background.
* Clear written and verbal communicator, able to explain infrastructure concepts (e.g. Kubernetes, runner sizing, build performance) to engineers without a platform background, and able to tailor the level of detail to the audience.
* Pragmatic and cost\-conscious: able to balance reliability, security, developer speed, and infrastructure cost, and to make and explain trade\-offs rather than defaulting to “more resources.”
* Ownership mindset with strong personal accountability; comfortable working autonomously and
  

driving initiatives from discovery through to rollout.
* Curious and continuously improving: proactively investigates root causes (e.g. inconsistent metrics, flaky runners) rather than just resolving symptoms.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities, and able to sequence and negotiate scope in a fast\-moving, PI\-based planning environment.
* Empathetic and collaborative when defining ownership boundaries between platform and product teams, favouring clarity and shared documentation over friction.

**Would be great if you have**


* Experience supporting mobile/device\-testing CI (e.g. Android emulator/KVM requirements, iOS
  

simulators) in a self\-hosted runner context.
* Experience with developing platform API and CLI for developers to consume blueprints and patterns using either Kratix or Crossplane tooling.
* Experience with large Kubernetes cluster fleet automation from provisioning to upgrade to
  

decommission Experience operating in a large monorepo, including build\-graph/dependency\-aware CI triggering.
* Prior experience defining or operating SLOs/SLAs and error budgets for internal platform services.

**Our offer**


In addition to a great company and challenging projects, we can offer much, much more:


* Agile and friendly atmosphere, non\-violent communication and full respect for diversity
* Possibility to choose remote work or on\-site (in Ł ódź, Poland)
* B2B or Employment Contract – you choose
* Remuneration on B2B contract: 1\.200–1\.400 PLN net/day
* Remuneration on Employment Agreement: 19\.000–22\.000 PLN gross per month

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced R\&D Software Architect focused on C\+\+ application development for performance‑critical systems to join our technology organization.  



In this role, you will lead the architecture of scalable, high\-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\), with a strong focus on real\-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.  



As an R\&D Architect within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.


You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting\-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real\-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long\-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.  



We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.  



  

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Lead system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real\-time operation.
* Architect interop layers connecting high\-performance C\+\+ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
* Drive performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reduce memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
* Propagate modern programming practices and techniques based on the latest C\+\+ standard.
* Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
* Mentor development teams on system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance\-critical sections.
* Lead technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
* Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices.
* Maintain cross\-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
* Drive Linux development and deployment strategies: architect solutions for Linux environments.
* Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality software solutions.
* Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
* Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain.
Actively participate in a cross\-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.  
* 

**Your Background:**

* University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of experience in senior technical or architecture roles.
* Advanced proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
* Proven experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real\-time system design.
* Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross\-platform development for Windows and Linux.
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns; demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low\-latency system; good understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
* Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
* Experience with Cloud, DevOps, deep cybersecurity expertise, UI/web development.
* Knowledge of non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
* Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring having familiarity with WAMS/WAMPAC, PMU data, and protection and control applications; understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards; experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU).
* Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC 61850, IEC\-60870\-5\-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37\.118\).
* Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients and exposure to system integration, simulators, or lab environments
* Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
* Solid understanding of numerical methods, signal processing, and control fundamentals and ability to work with high‑frequency, time‑aligned time‑series data
* Good understanding of power system dynamics and the stability challenges introduced by high penetration of renewables
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges; effective team player with good communication skills and willingness to learn.
Excellent command of English (written and spoken).  
* 

  

**More about us**
-----------------

  

We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.


We can provide more information during the recruitment process.  



  

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:


* Private medical care and life insurance
* Access to fitness and wellness programs
* Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
* Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
* Company events and team‑building activities
* Psychological support program
Free parking available  
* 

  

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.


**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a workplace where you are empowered to shape your career in the way you envision, where you become part of a supportive and inspiring community of engaged colleagues around the world, and where you have the opportunity to redefine what is possible. Our Cloud \& Custom Applications teams focus on developing tailored, scalable, and secure cloud applications, integrating IT systems, and driving business transformation. AI is a key technology in everything we do and a central part of how we design and build modern systems and solutions. Intelligent AI\-driven ways of working and technologies such as Agentic AI are accelerating innovation and shaping the future. Join us and help shape the next generation of systems together with world\-leading organizations, while contributing to unlocking the full potential of technology in a more sustainable and inclusive world.


**.**
-----


**Your Role**


As a Platform Engineer Specialist at Capgemini, you will help clients design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and self\-service platform solutions. You will combine hands\-on engineering with platform strategy, automation, developer enablement, governance, and operational excellence.
  

Platform Engineering is becoming one of the most important disciplines in modern software development. Organisations are investing heavily in developer platforms, cloud\-native technologies, automation and AI\-enabled engineering to help teams deliver software faster, more securely and at greater scale. We are growing our Platform Engineering capability across Sweden and are looking for Platform Engineers and Senior Platform Engineers who want to help clients solve complex engineering challenges, modernise software delivery and build platforms that enable hundreds, and sometimes thousands, of developers.
  

This is a client\-facing consulting role where you will combine hands\-on engineering with architecture, automation, platform strategy and developer enablement. You will work with leading organisations across multiple industries, helping them establish modern platform capabilities that accelerate innovation while maintaining high standards for security, reliability and governance.


This is a client\-facing consulting role, and your work setup may vary between hybrid, onsite, or client\-based engagements depending on the assignment. You can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Helsingborg, Malmö, Växjö, or Älmhult.  

  

  



**In this role, you will play a key part in:**


* Design, build, and operate cloud\-native platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and OpenShift, enabling modern delivery through CI/CD, self\-service tooling, and internal developer platforms.
* Developing golden paths, reusable templates, platform APIs, and service catalogues that make it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate services.
* Driving automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Establishing platform standards, reference architectures and governance including platform security, identity and access management, observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.

Support clients in moving AI initiatives from experimentation to secure, scalable, production\-ready solutions.  
* 

**Your profile**


* Hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related field.
* A strong understanding of modern platform engineering principles and how self\-service solutions can improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.
* Programming or scripting experience using Python, Go, C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience in applying security, governance, and responsible AI principles in an enterprise environment.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Amazon Q, Gemini Code Assist, or similar.
* A practical understanding of modern AI concepts and patterns, including LLMs, prompting, context engineering, RAG, evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* The ability to combine strategic platform thinking with hands\-on technical delivery in complex environments.

Clear communication with technical teams and client stakeholders, and an interest in working in a consulting context.  
* 

*We do not expect you to know about every technology on this list. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, hands\-on experience, and the ability to understand how infrastructure, software delivery, security, operations, and developer needs fit together*


**.**
-----


**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**


* Being part of a growing Platform Engineering capability where your expertise and ideas can make a visible impact.
* Working across diverse client environments, industries, technologies, and delivery models.
* Collaborating with skilled colleagues locally and globally, with access to strong technical communities and development opportunities.
* Contributing to initiatives within cloud, platform automation, developer enablement, and AI\-assisted engineering.

Helping clients build solutions that are secure, scalable, sustainable, and valuable in real business contexts.  
* 

**Application**  

  

We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter at Helene.yde@capgemini.com


*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.*
  

\#LI\-HY1


Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end\-to\-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market\-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22\.5 billion.


Make it real \| www.capgemini.com

Agila arbetssätt och nära samarbete med utvecklare, arkitekter, produktägare och andra intressenter
  
AI\-baserade verktyg som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen
  
  

Som senior utvecklare förväntas du vara kommunikativ, bidra i tekniska diskussioner, ta ansvar för lösningar och vid behov stötta och coacha andra utvecklare.
  
  

Du bör ha arbetat MINST 4 år med flera av följande tekniker och områden:
  
C\#, .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST API, Blazor, Vue, Microservices, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL eller andra databaser, Azure, AWS eller annan molnplattform, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Kafka eller andra event\- och meddelandeplattformar, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, DevOps, Testautomatisering, Agila arbetssätt och Scrum.
  
  

AI som kraftfullt hjälpmedel i utvecklingen
  
Vi ser AI som ett kraftfullt hjälpmedel för att öka effektiviteten och skapa mer värde till våra kunder snabbare – inte som ett facit.
  
Vi vill att du har erfarenhet av AI där vi bland annat använder det till att:
  
Bidra till högre system\- och applikationssäkerhet, identifiera risker och attackytor
  
Snabbare skapa och testa lösningar och korta tiden från idé till konkret kundvärde
  
Effektivisera utveckling, felsökning och dokumentation
  
Förbättra kodkvalitet och testning
  
Analysera och förstå stora eller komplexa kodbaser
  
Automatisera repetitiva delar av utvecklingsprocessen
  
Skapa snabbare iterationer och bättre beslutsunderlag
  
  

Vem är du?
  
Har flera års professionell erfarenhet av backend\- och systemutveckling
  
Har gedigen erfarenhet av C\# och .NET
  
Är van att arbeta med moderna ramverk, verktyg och utvecklingsmetoder
  
Förstår vikten av kvalitet, säkerhet, prestanda och skalbarhet
  
Kan ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar från idé till produktion
  
Gillar att dela kunskap och diskutera tekniska lösningar med andra
  
Är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta både inom teamet och med kunden
  
Är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att lära dig nya saker
  
Har ett intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas för att effektivisera och förbättra systemutveckling
  
  

Som senior utvecklare ser vi gärna att du också är bekväm med att bidra till arkitekturdiskussioner, stötta andra utvecklare och utmana befintliga tekniska lösningar när det finns bättre alternativ.
  
  

Hos Sigma
  
Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor och kunder i tekniskt spännande miljöer. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar, kunskapsdelning och att människor utvecklas bäst när de får möjlighet att ta sig an utmaningar som både stimulerar, utvecklar och skapar nya möjligheter.
  
Gemenskapen är en viktig del av vilka vi är. Vi har roligt tillsammans, umgås och hittar regelbundet på aktiviteter, event och gemensamma äventyr. Varje år reser vi utomlands tillsammans.
  
Just nu befinner vi oss i en mycket spännande och expansiv fas i Blekinge. Regionen växer, investeringarna ökar och behovet av teknisk kompetens är stort. Sigmas fortsatta satsning i Blekinge går hand i hand med regionens utveckling, och vi vill fortsätta att vara en aktiv del i att bygga den kompetens och innovationskraft som behövs framåt.

jobs.title: Photonics Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Thorlabs Sweden i Mölndal söker nu ytterligare en ingenjör till vår Tech\-supportavdelning inom fotonik
  
OM JOBBET
  
Som Photonics Support Engineer kommer du att arbeta i ett litet team med erfarna ingenjörer som ansvarar för teknisk support till våra kunder med både rekommendationer före beställning och hjälp med befintlig utrustning. Du kommer ha stort eget ansvar att driva ditt eget arbete framåt, men i mycket tätt samarbete och stöd av övriga medlemmar i gruppen. Du kommer även att samarbeta med ingenjörer från andra delar av koncernen med stor kunskap och erfarenhet inom de specialområden våra kunder jobbar med, som exempelvis optisk mätteknink, optik, lasrar och ljuskällor, optiska fibrer och spektroskopi. Det finns också möjligheter till resor till våra andra kontor för utbildningar och utbyten.
  
Här i Mölndal utvecklas och tillverkas optiska system, som exempelvis objektiv och avancerade fiberkollimatorer samt instrument för spektroskopi. Genom nära samarbete med våra egna utvecklingsingenjörer kommer du få möjlighet att bygga specialistkunskap inom dessa produktkategorier. För att utveckla produktförståelsen finns dessutom tid till praktiskt arbete i vårt eget lab. I rollen ingår även att representera Thorlabs på mässor inom fotonikområdet, och till viss del kundbesök.
  
  

OM DIG
  
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har en högskoleutbildning inom fysik eller motsvarande, gärna med inriktning mot eller examensarbete inom fotonik/optik. Har du praktisk erfarenhet av fotonik/optik\-lab, av optiska simuleringar i Zemax och arbete med kundkontakt är det ett stort plus. Det är även meriterande med kunskaper inom elektronik och programmering i tex Python, C\# eller LabView.
  
Vi söker dig som är kommunikativ och har lätt för att ge förklaringar på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Du är intresserad av att lära dig nya saker och tycker det är kul att hitta lösningar på frågor som du från start inte har svaret på. Då kundkontakt är en central del av tjänsten är det viktigt att du har en stor vilja att förstå kundernas utmaningar och ett engagemang i att hitta bästa lösningen för dem.
  
För att trivas hos oss ser vi att du gillar att självständigt finna lösningar och ta egna initiativ, men även aktivt samarbeta med kollegor för att tillsammans nå ett bra resultat. Du trivs med att jobba med internationella kontakter, och har mycket goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska, både i tal och skrift.
  
  

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN
  
Hos oss på Thorlabs får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team i en internationell miljö där varje dag bjuder på nya utmaningar och möjligheter. Vi är stolta över att erbjuda en trygg och långsiktig anställning med tekniskt spännande produkter och stor möjlighet till personlig utveckling och stort eget ansvar. Utvecklingsmöjligheter finns både i vår lokala och europeiska organisation. Arbetet sker huvudsakligen på plats i våra lokaler, där vi samarbetar och stöttar varandra för att nå våra gemensamma mål.
  
Våra ljusa och moderna lokaler i Mölndal skapar en trivsam arbetsmiljö där vi värnar om både prestation och välmående. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider som gör det lättare att balansera arbete och fritid, tjänstepension för din trygghet på lång sikt, friskvårdsbidrag som uppmuntrar till god hälsa samt sjukvårdsförsäkring som ger dig extra trygghet om du skulle behöva det. Vi är även anslutna till kollektivavtal, vilket innebär att du får bra villkor och rättvisa förmåner.
  
Ansök gärna redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum.
  
  

OM FÖRETAGET
  
Thorlabs Sweden AB är en del av en global koncern med över 3 000 anställda världen över. Med en produktportfölj som omfattar mer än 20 000 artiklar är vi en ledande leverantör av fotonikprodukter för forskning och utveckling inom akademi, industri och sjukvård.
  
Koncernen bedriver både försäljning, utveckling och tillverkning på flera platser i USA, Europa och Asien. Vår verksamhet i Sverige etablerades 2004 och har idag 90 medarbetare i moderna lokaler i Mölndal, strax utanför Göteborg.
  
Med avancerade testmiljöer och ett modernt renrum är Thorlabs Sweden särskilt väl rustat för utveckling och tillverkning av högteknologiska optiska system. Vi ansvarar även för teknisk support av samtliga produkter i Thorlabs katalog samt för försäljningsverksamheten i Skandinavien, Baltikum och Polen.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description** **Hej Software Engineer!**

**Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone?**  

  

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.  

  

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area: “Product Engineering”, a part of Digital Engineering at Inter IKEA, Range. The Product Engineering Area is dedicated to ensuring an attractive, consistent, and efficient way of working for product development and our suppliers. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation for IKEA's product information, enabling its seamless use across the entire value chain. We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, but you need to have great communication and collaboration skills to be able to integrate our offshore team.

  



**Your new job**  

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who wants to solve complex, real\-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on developing solutions for the handling of materials in our product designers work and you’ll report to a Software Engineering Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:

* Build and evolve our material management solution, a core part of IKEA's digital landscape.
* Develop web applications, APIs, and cloud services using Next.js, .NET, and Azure.
* Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and design to delivery and continuous improvement.
* Be part of a team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and openness, while actively sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* Bring curiosity and contribute ideas that improve both our products and ways of working.
* Ensure high\-quality software through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices.

 **Qualifications** **What we’d like you to bring to the table**  

  

This role as a Software Engineer requires you to:

* Be highly skilled and experienced within React, NextJs and Typescript, a minimum of 3\-5 years of work life experience
* Be highly skilled and experienced within C\# and .NET framework, a minimum of 3\-5 years of work life experience
* Have good knowledge of Azure.
* Have good interpersonal skills: active listening, coaching and facilitation.
* Be an excellent communicator by communicating in a clear, structured and honest way – both with inhouse and offshore team and colleagues
* Have a deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this


It’s a plus if you also:

* Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services
* Have knowledge of database technologies like MongoDB, Postgres DB
* Have experience with Jest/Playwright for Frontend testing
* Are skilled in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React

 **Additional Information** **Be yourself, a Software Engineer and more!**  

  

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.  

  

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co\-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down\-to\-earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.  



**We welcome your application**  

  

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of October at the latest.  

  

This is a permanent role based in Malmö; hence, you need to be based in Sweden and be able to work from the office. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace are important.  

  

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Vera Bendz, Recruiter, at vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. If you have questions about the role, please contact Marie Önnemyr, Hiring Manager, at marie.onnemyr@inter.ikea.com.  

  

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, or what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs.  

  

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

*We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co\-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co\-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.*

* Du bör ha erfarenhet från minst 2 projekt/uppdrag av modernisering eller migrering från on\-premise till GCP.
* Du bör ha erfarenhet av eventdriven arkitektur, exempelvis Kafka, RedPanda eller motsvarande, från minst 2 projekt/uppdrag.
* Du bör ha erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code (IaC) för molninfrastruktur från minst 1 projekt/uppdrag.
* Du bör ha erfarenhet av prestandaoptimering av distribuerade backendsystem med höga krav på svarstider och genomströmning från minst 1 projekt/uppdrag.
* Du bör ha erfarenhet av backendutveckling i Scala och/eller Java från minst 1 projekt/uppdrag.
* Du bör ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och implementera AI\-agenter integrerade med externa system, API eller datakällor från minst 1 projekt/uppdrag.

  

**Sista ansökningdatum:** 07\-10\-2026
