jobs.title: Software Engineer, Professional Services (January 2027)
jobs.description:
### **Ongoing is searching for focused and knowledgeable people to strengthen our team of engineers**

#### **Start date: January 2027**

### **About the company**


Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Ongoing is a leading cloud\-native WMS for logistics\-intensive companies, including both third\-party logistics (‘3PL’) providers as well as businesses that operate their own warehouses.Designed for organisations with scaling or established warehouse operations with demanding logistics requirements, the platform delivers real\-time inventory control, goods management, customer communication and advanced analytics that reduce manual work and errors. With its user\-friendly interface and scalable platform, Ongoing enables organisations to improve efficiency, enhance order accuracy, and gain full visibility across their supply chain, empowering them to adapt quickly in an increasingly fast\-paced market.


Since July 2026, Ongoing has been a portfolio company of Cinven, a leading pan\-European private equity firm. This marks the beginning of an exciting new growth phase, with continued international expansion and increasing demand for the expertise of our Professional Services team, who work closely with customers to implement, optimise, and develop business\-critical warehouse management solutions.

*Join a team where you'll gain hands\-on experience and contribute to projects that create real value for customers. Here, Jonathan and Eric from Professional Services collaborate on customer solutions and implementation projects.*

#### **About the position**


As an engineer, you will help new and existing customers to develop their businesses by using our web\-based Logistics solution. The work will give you a unique insight into the ever\-changing market of Logistics and its software ecosystem. The work is primarily done from our pleasant office at Johanneberg, Gothenburg, but can also include visits to our customers. The position is full\-time. There are several different ways to continue your career at Ongoing.

*Ongoing WMS handles a large amount of data. Performance, reliability, and security are important. In the role, you will learn how to manage large data quantities using Microsoft SQL Server.*

#### **About you**


Ongoing is looking for engineers who are interested in IT and software and its usage as a tool for developing businesses. We are a company with a strong focus on close collaboration and helping our customers and are therefore looking for a flexible and customer\-oriented person. We think that you can understand and analyze our customers' businesses but also the capacity to learn how a large software solution works. To enjoy working in our team you should be open\-minded and without prestige.

*Learn from experienced colleagues from day one. Here, Gustav from the Integrations team and Måns, Team Lead within Professional Services, discuss a customer solution and share expertise across teams to help customers get the most out of Ongoing.*

*You are expected to know some programming but not C\# specifically. Ongoing WMS is built using C\#.*

#### **Qualifications**


Most importantly, you should be excited about working in a fast\-growing software company where curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and adaptability are key to success. Backed by Cinven, Ongoing is entering an exciting new phase of international growth while maintaining the entrepreneurial culture that has been central to our success. Full professional proficiency in English and a Nordic language is required, and additional language skills are considered an advantage.


We welcome applicants who hold, or are in the final stages of completing, a Master's degree. Our colleagues come from a wide range of engineering disciplines and academic backgrounds, bringing diverse perspectives and expertise to the team. You should have an interest in IT and software development.


*Most of the engineers at Ongoing have a master’s degree from Chalmers equivalent technical university. The office is also located directly next to the Johanneberg campus.*

### **Terms**


At Ongoing, you can expect the employer to challenge as well as care about you. We pay competitive salaries for skilled employees which can help the company to further develop. We also offer a healthy working environment with many other perks. Learn more about how we work at Ongoing.


Start date: January 2027

 *Our top\-floor ping\-pong table is appreciated for breaking off between hard work. Many, but not all, colleagues also like using the health benefits for running, gym, padel, squash, tennis, golf, or other activities.*

jobs.title: Senior Professional Mechanical Engineer - Projects & Overhauls
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29205
Category: Engineering \- Mechanical
Job Type: Full\-time  

The Generation Engineering department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects (EMP) is the centre of engineering for ESB’s generation businesses. The Projects \& Overhauls department function within Generation Engineering is to aide ESB Generation \& Trading (G\&T) in the delivery of overhauls \& outages across the asset portfolio, both thermal \& Hydro focused.  



We currently have an opportunity for Senior Mechanical Engineers within the Projects \& Overhauls Team in Generation Engineering. The successful candidate will support ESB with the management of overhaul projects on existing assets for ESB G\&T.

  

Suitable candidates will lead the technical delivery of plant overhauls across the ESB Generation portfolio. Aligned with same, candidates should have a background in construction, commissioning, maintenance, or operation of:

  

* Gas Turbine Technology.
* Steam Turbine Technology.
* Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSGs) \& Boiler technologies.
* High Energy Piping.
* Hydroelectric Turbine Technology.
* Power Generation Balance of Plant Technologies.
  

**Key Responsibilities**


Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to the following:

  

* **Support Overhaul Planning \& Programme:** Aide the Station \& Project Manager in the planning phase through to safe \& efficient delivery of the Overhaul / Outages.
* **Support the Asset Management Process:** Support on technical input, liaison with Asset Specialists \& reporting on assets pre/post overhaul to the aide in the Long\-Term Asset Planning.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Dublin)
jobs.description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short\-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger premium beach destinations, long\-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks and that’s just the beginning of our story.


We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.


Powered by our deep\-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating \- delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.


Ready to build the future of travel with us?

**About the Role**


We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to be part of our Inventory Engineering Team, responsible for supplier integrations, inventory management, and booking reliability.


This high\-impact role balances team leadership (75%) and hands\-on contribution (25%), driving both technical execution and operational excellence while scaling a world\-class engineering team.


We’ve been transforming how we acquire, manage, and distribute travel inventory, moving from fragmented supplier integrations to a unified, scalable platform. While we’ve made great progress, there’s still plenty to optimise.


Our platform powers supplier connectivity, data acquisition, distribution, and booking workflows, ensuring fresh, high\-quality inventory with minimal latency. Built on C\# .NET and AWS, it supports a fast\-moving, high\-traffic environment.

**What you’ll be doing day to day**

* Managing a team of IC Software Engineers up to Staff level and owning up to three domains.
* Empower teams to deliver high\-quality software across the stack, from frontend to platform and data services.
* Drive delivery excellence over multiple release cycles; leverage modern delivery methodologies and team management techniques to help teams achieve their potential.
* Communicate the value of technical work to Product and Business stakeholders helping prioritise investments like refactors, rebuilds, and platform modernisation.
* Support organisational change, including team reorganisation, leadership transitions, and scaling challenges.
* Build, grow, and hire exceptional engineering talent, with a focus on speed, diversity, and quality.
* Handle performance and people processes with empathy and fairness.
* Coach, mentor, and guide career progression for engineers and emerging leaders helping people step into new roles and grow beyond senior levels!
* Foster a culture of self\-awareness, adaptability, and continuous learning articulating and flexing your leadership style as needed.
* Own the team backlog, facilitate tech and product decisions and plan delivery with support from Architects, Designers and Product Managers.

**You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience**

* Experience in engineering management roles, with a strong hands\-on technical foundation.
* Proven experience managing teams of multiple engineers as well as leading managers or tech leads.
* Track record of delivering complex full\-stack systems (web/mobile frontend, backend, data, platform).
* Skilled at balancing delivery, technical quality, and business impact able to make and communicate tough trade\-offs.
* Experience leading through change from reorganisation to leadership transitions.
* Strong communicator able to express the “why” behind technical work in terms that stakeholders value.
* Deep understanding of modern software delivery practices from DORA metrics to team health tracking and tooling.
* Experienced in hiring and building teams quickly, with strong opinions on what makes a great engineering culture.
* Demonstrated ability to coach others with examples of helping people grow into new roles or management careers.
* Self\-aware and reflective, able to articulate your leadership style and how it evolves across situations.

**What to expect from our interview process**


After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process. Which will consist of:


Hiring Manager meet \& greet \- 30 Minutes  

Behavioural \& ways of working \- 60 Minutes  

System Design \- 60 Minutes


We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.


You’ll find diverse teams at OTB, reflective of the world we live in and the customers we serve. We believe strongly that difference, not uniformity, is critical to our success. We know that better decisions happen when they are made by a range of voices, perspectives and experiences. As an equal opportunity employer, we value and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

**Ways of working**  

Our full time hours are 37\.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you and the team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Dublin)
jobs.description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short\-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger \- premium beach destinations, long\-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks, and that’s just the beginning of our story.


We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.


Powered by our deep\-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating \- delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.


Ready to build the future of travel with us?

**About the Role**


As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.


This is a full\-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud\-native architecture.


Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.


You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

**What you’ll be doing day to day**

* Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
* Developing APIs used by customer\-facing applications and internal systems
* Integrating with external suppliers and third\-party platforms
* Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
* Designing distributed and event\-driven architectures
* Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
* Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
* Improving caching and data\-access strategies
* Building reliable transactional workflows
* Developing applications and services within AWS
* Deploying and operating containerised applications
* Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
* Exploring AI\-assisted engineering and modern development tooling


At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.


You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.


We’re looking for strong full\-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

**You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience**

* Strong commercial backend software engineering
* C\# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
* Designing and developing APIs
* Building distributed systems and service\-oriented architectures
* Developing cloud\-native applications, ideally within AWS
* Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event\-driven architecture
* Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
* SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
* Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
* Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
* Designing for resilience and failure
* Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
* Automated testing and modern engineering practices


We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

**Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:**

* Can independently solve complex engineering problems
* Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
* Understands the trade\-offs between speed, quality and long\-term maintainability
* Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
* Communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical colleagues
* Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
* Helps less experienced engineers develop
* Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

**What to expect from our interview process**


After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process. Which will consist of:  

Hiring Manager meet \& greet \- 30 Minutes  

Behavioural \& ways of working \- 60 Minutes  

Tech Pairing \& System Design \- 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.


We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.


You’ll find diverse teams at OTB, reflective of the world we live in and the customers we serve. We believe strongly that difference, not uniformity, is critical to our success. We know that better decisions happen when they are made by a range of voices, perspectives and experiences. As an equal opportunity employer, we value and welcome applications from all sections of the community.

**Ways of working**  

Our full time hours are 37\.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am \- 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.


We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and a minimum of one day every two weeks in our Dublin workspace.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Manufacturing Test Software Engineer
**Description \-**

We are looking for a Manufacturing Test Software Engineer to join our team and help develop reliable, scalable, and high\-quality manufacturing test solutions for HP products.


In this role, you will work with product development, factory, quality, and external partners to design, implement, validate, and improve test software used in manufacturing. You will support both new product introduction and sustaining programs, helping to ensure product quality, production readiness, and factory efficiency.


This role is ideal for junior\-to\-mid level engineers who enjoy software development, test automation, problem solving, and working closely with both engineering and manufacturing teams. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, image processing, and advanced automation to improve test coverage, strengthen defect detection, and optimize manufacturing efficiency.


Engineers with strong programming fundamentals and a keen interest in test automation, embedded systems, image processing, or AI/ML applications are also welcome to apply.


Key Responsibilities


* Develop and support manufacturing test solutions with product development and production teams to ensure product quality, performance, and manufacturability.
* Design, implement, and validate test software for new and existing products across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and system\-level requirements.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to support project execution, production readiness, and issue resolution.
* Support the creation, validation, and delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and high\-quality manufacturing test packages.
* Represent the manufacturing test team in project discussions, technical reviews, and issue\-resolution forums.
* Provide training, documentation, and technical support to users within and outside HP.
* Improve test software robustness and support factory and quality teams in troubleshooting production issues.
* Analyze test failures, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to product design, test coverage, and manufacturing quality.
* Optimize test solutions to improve throughput, reduce test cycle time, and enhance factory productivity.

Knowledge and Skills


* Experience or strong interest in software development, test automation, embedded systems, firmware, image processing, AI/ML, and autonomous or agentic solutions.
* Programming knowledge in languages and tools such as Python, SQL, VB, C\#, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with data analysis, software testing methodology, test plan execution, debugging, test scripts, and automation tools.
* Interest or exposure to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and related frameworks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand software, hardware, and system\-level requirements and translate them into practical test solutions.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and adapt to changing requirements.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and local language.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

Scope and Impact


* Supports product quality, manufacturing readiness, delivery timelines, and factory efficiency.
* Works closely with software engineering leaders, architects, technology leads, product development teams, factories, and external partners.
* Contributes to timely technical issue resolution and continuous improvement of manufacturing test effectiveness.

Education and Experience


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
Position Summary:


The Manufacturing Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting digital manufacturing solutions across MES, equipment data systems, operational applications, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled manufacturing capabilities.


This role partners with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and OT teams to build and sustain data\-driven manufacturing workflows that improve operational efficiency, equipment reliability, troubleshooting effectiveness, and digital transformation initiatives
  

  

Position Responsibilities:


* Design, develop, and support digital/AI manufacturing solutions that improve operational efficiency, data visibility, and decision\-making across manufacturing operations.
* Design and support system integrations between manufacturing and equipment enterprise systems, equipment data sources and enterprise data platforms.
* Develop and optimize databases, data pipelines, APIs, and reporting solutions to ensure reliable and scalable manufacturing data flows.

* Strong database design and development experience using Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, views, and stored procedures.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or equivalent object\-oriented languages.
* Experience developing and supporting software applications, APIs, and system integrations.

* Demonstrated success developing agents that interact with and coordinate activities across multiple business platforms and technology ecosystems.

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities

* Experience with Power BI, Databricks, Azure, cloud technologies, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and analytics platforms.
* Experience implementing AI solutions within large, global enterprises
* Exposure to operational technology, equipment connectivity, or industrial automation environments.
* Knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, enterprise knowledge management, and RAG solution patterns.

* Knowledge of AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, diagnostic solutions, knowledge management systems
* Experience working in regulated manufacturing, medical device, biotechnology, life sciences, semiconductor, or high\-tech manufacturing environments.
Demonstrated interest in digital transformation, manufacturing systems integration, data\-driven operations, and smart manufacturing initiatives.

jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.

--------------------


* Designing and developing the web\-based 3D IFC model viewer, from architecture through to implementation
* Exploring and evaluating relevant open\-source libraries and tools (e.g. IFC parsers, WebGL frameworks)
* Implementing model navigation features (e.g. object selection, section cuts, and property inspection, etc.)
* Collaborating with backend engineers on server\-side geometry processing and data APIs
* Optimising viewer performance when dealing with large, complex files
* Iterating on the viewer based on feedback from end users
**Requirements**
----------------


* Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript and backend JS runtimes (e.g. Node.js/Deno)
* Good understanding of 3D graphics and/or computational geometry concepts
* Strong problem solving skills and a desire to learn
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Familiarity with any of the following would be a plus:


* Web development (Frontend/Backend/Full\-stack)
* WebGL or related 3D frameworks (e.g. Babylon.js)
* Python and libraries like IfcOpenShell
* Building Information Modeling (BIM) concepts
* Geospatial data and information
* Agentic development workflows (e.g Claude Code)
* WebAssembly
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**


Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.


As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a
  
  

Senior Software Engineer
  
  

on our Global Test Engineering Team in
  
  

Singapore.

Develop, review and implement test strategies for products and systems.
  
  

Clearly communicate project issues and status. Analyse and prepare trend reports on quality metrics. Participate in improving product quality through process and procedure improvements. Manage conference calls with global factories.
  
  

Take the first step towards your dream career

jobs.title: Senior CI/CD Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SIOUX
  
  

Sioux Group was founded in 1996 in the Netherlands. With over 1,400 engineers, Sioux supports or acts as the R\&D partner of leading high\-tech companies. We aim to add value to our clients by developing innovative and high\-tech solutions that contribute to a smarter, safer, healthier, more enjoyable, and more sustainable society.
  
  

Sioux has been recognized as an employer of choice, including awards such as Best ICT Company to Work For and Great Place to Work. In addition to our strong presence in Europe, Sioux is rapidly expanding in Asia, with offices in Vietnam, China, Singapore, and India.
  
  

With a strong heritage and a diverse international team, Sioux is proud of our core values: Own it and make it happen, Grow and innovate together, and Surprise customers. If these values resonate with you, we would love to welcome you to our team.
  
  

We are looking for a Senior CI/CD Engineer based in Asia to make our builds faster, our pipelines more reliable, and our automated testing part of every change. You will focus on build performance for our C\#/.NET and C\+\+ software and on bringing tests and static analysis into CI. You will work closely with development, verification, our test architect and IT\-DevOps teams in Europe and Asia.
  
  

Today, a full end\-to\-end pipeline runs around 200 jobs and over 10,000 automated tests and takes about 4 hours. Your main goal is to cut that time significantly (we aim for around 50% in your first year) while giving developers fast, reliable feedback on every merge request. This is a hands\-on CI/CD role inside engineering, not an infrastructure DevOps role. You will spend most of your time optimising builds and pipelines, and a smaller share keeping them running.
  
  

Key Initiatives
  
  

**Reduce Pipeline Time:**  

Map the critical path, remove waiting between jobs, cut per\-job overhead (clone, artifact download, restore) and cancel redundant pipelines automatically.
  
  

**Job Strategy:**  

**Decide what runs where and when:** fast merge request checks, fuller runs on main and release branches, and complete nightly runs. Group short jobs, split long ones and parallelise long system test suites.
  
  

**Tests in the Pipeline:**  

With the test architect, place each test type in the right pipeline tier, select tests by change where safe, quarantine flaky tests and move coverage runs to scheduled pipelines.
  
  

**Release Pipelines:**  

Make release and cherry\-pick pipelines fast and predictable so fixes reach customers quickly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Build Performance:**  

Profile and optimise MSBuild\-based builds for C\#/.NET Framework 4\.7 and C\+\+: incremental and parallel builds, NuGet and dependency caching, and removal of bottlenecks.
  
  

**Pipeline Design:**  

Design, standardise and maintain reusable GitLab CI pipeline templates (.gitlab\-ci.yml, DAGs, multi\-project pipelines) across C\#, C\+\+ and Python repositories.
  
  

**Test \& Verification Integration:**  

With the test architect, development and QA/verification leads, embed unit tests, static analysis (Coverity, SonarQube) and automated test bench runs into CI, with clear results reporting. Agree jointly with the test architect which suites run in each pipeline tier.
  
  

**Pipeline Reliability \& Metrics:**  

Investigate failures, remove flaky builds and tests, and track build time, failure rate and pipeline uptime on dashboards to show improvement.
  
  

**Pipeline Operations:**  

Act as first line on the engineering side when pipelines or runners go down: diagnose, restart or re\-run jobs, unblock developers, and hand infrastructure issues to IT\-DevOps with a clear diagnosis.
  
  

**Capacity Input:**  

Give IT\-DevOps data\-backed requirements for build runners and test environments, based on queue times and job durations.
  
  

**Artifact \& Release Automation:**  

Automate versioning, release packaging, artifact staging and package registry management.
  
  

**Developer Workflow:**  

Advise teams on branching and merge strategies, merge request verification gates and fast feedback loops.
  
  

**Scope:**  

GitLab runner management, AWS/cloud infrastructure and GitLab platform administration are owned by the IT\-DevOps team. This role works with them on requirements and issues but does not own that infrastructure. It is their engineering\-side point of contact: first line when pipelines are down, and input on sizing what we need.
  
  

Job requirements
  
  

**Required Qualifications \& Skills:**  

**Experience:**  

5\+ years in CI/CD, build engineering or release automation for multi\-repository C\#/.NET and C\+\+ codebases.
  
  

**Build Systems:**  

Deep hands\-on experience with MSBuild and .NET Framework 4\.x builds on Windows; experience with C\+\+ builds (MSBuild/CMake).
  
  

**CI/CD Platform:**  

**Strong GitLab CI/CD skills:** pipeline authoring, DAGs, multi\-project pipelines, caching and artifact management.
  
  

**Scripting:**  

Strong PowerShell and Python for pipeline logic, build orchestration and log analysis; our build also includes Python\-based simulation.
  
  

**Test Execution in CI:**  

Experience splitting, grouping and parallelising long\-running test suites, and detecting and managing flaky tests.
  
  

**Containers:**  

Working knowledge of Docker for build and test jobs.
  
  

**Problem\-Solving \& Communication:**  

Able to root\-cause complex build, link and test integration failures; clear, fluent English for working across regions.
  
  

Preferred/ Good to Have
  
  

Experience in semiconductor equipment, high\-tech machine automation, or hardware/software integration environments.
  
  

Hands\-on use of Coverity, SonarQube and test management tools (Xray, Jira).
  
  

Experience with build acceleration or distributed build tools.
  
  

Experience migrating old\-style .csproj projects to SDK\-style.
  
  

WHAT WE CAN OFFER
  
  

Our employees are our strength and together we want to achieve the maximum. That is why we invest a lot in our employees, through generous development budgets and personal attention. According to our employees, this is what makes the difference at Sioux. We are proud of that. For us, success is more than just a good salary: it is also about feeling valued, getting responsibilities, and to be able continuously develop oneself.
  
  

No matter how experienced you are, you will continue to develop yourself on a personal level and in terms of content. You have a personal training budget of 5,000 SGD available for this, every year.
  
  

Varied work due to the diversity in technologies, markets, and projects
  
  

An open culture that focuses on collaboration, learning, and having fun
  
  

An innovative work environment
  
  

Job Location
  
  

Our office is conveniently located next to the
  
  

Tai Seng MRT station.
  
  

Sioux Technologies is a high\-tech services and solutions provider, headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands with R\&D centers in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, China, Singapore and Vietnam.
  
  

We have a track record in the development of Medical, Traffic, Transport and Infrastructure, Semiconductor, Automotive and Agrotech smart solutions for more than 24 years.
  
  

Our 750 engineers generated a turnover of more than USD 100 Mil in 2019\. Over 60% are software focus. We have end to end capabilities from POC to early production stage.
  
  

With vast competencies in the areas of Mathware, multidisciplinary and multiple industry domain knowledge, as well as pure/applied research bridging experience, the company is looking to offer its technological expertise to MNCs or SMEs of all sizes.

jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


In Thermo Fisher Scientific Brno, we develop and produce high\-tech electron microscopes and spectrometers. Our devices are involved in research of SARS\-CoV\-2 virus or enable mobile phones to get smaller. Our work contributes to making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We are the most prominent production site of electron microscopes worldwide, following a tradition of over 70 years long. There are many experts in physics, electronics, software, mechanical engineering, and logistics among us.


At the Sample Prep and Analysis (SPA) group, we develop and maintain software solutions that automate the operation of Scanning Electron Microscopes (SEMs). Our technology enables customers in the semiconductor industry to identify manufacturing defects, accelerate research, and improve the reliability, performance, and energy efficiency of next\-generation semiconductor devices.

**What will you be working on?**


We are looking for a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to help deliver high\-quality software across our product portfolio.


In this role, you will work closely with software engineers, product owners, system architects, and domain experts to ensure our software meets high standards of reliability, performance, and user experience. You will contribute to quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle, design and execute test strategies, develop and maintain automated tests, and help identify opportunities to improve testing processes and product quality.


This is an exciting opportunity to work with software that controls highly sophisticated scientific instruments with nanometer precision in an international R\&D environment. You will apply modern quality engineering practices, leverage test automation and AI\-assisted testing approaches, and contribute to the robustness of software that supports the development and production of the world’s most advanced semiconductor chips and memory technologies.

**Responsibilities:**

* Participating on all phases of product development cycle as SQA engineer.
* Support agile team in collaboration, problem solving, so that team can deliver high quality, innovative software on time.
* Develop and sustain relationships with vendors and joint development partners that support and accelerate the team’s development activities.
* Guard the software quality, development processes and their implementation in the organisation.
* Verifying accurate functionality of product features
* Verifying bug fixes
* Maintaining test scenario documentation
* Preparing SQA recommendation reports
* Identify risks during execution and help with their mitigation.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in related field required
* 3\+ years in agile software development
* Experience with software development process

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Strong written and verbal communications skills
* Ability to use data and metrics to identify and address problems and drive continuous improvement
* Focus on quality and robustness

* Desire and ability to work in an international context and diverse R\&D team that is multi\-disciplinary

**What technologies are we using?**

* We are using C\#, .NET standard, Python

**Overview**  

**Your internship:**
--------------------

**Location: Microsoft Romania****Duration: 12 weeks, full\-time****Start: July 2027****Work model: On\-site**

What if your internship project didn't sit on the sidelines, but contributed to the infrastructure behind one of the world's largest cloud platforms? At Microsoft, interns work on real\-world projects with teams across the world. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment, learn quickly, contribute ideas, and make an impact from the start.
Azure Core builds the foundational infrastructure and platform capabilities that power Microsoft Azure. As a Software Engineering Intern with Azure Core, you'll join engineering teams working on the foundational technologies behind Microsoft Azure. You'll have the opportunity to solve real engineering problems, write production\-quality software, learn from experienced engineers, and see how systems are designed and operated at cloud scale. Our engineering teams work across areas such as compute, networking, storage, cloud\-native technologies, fleet management, operating systems, virtualization, and distributed systems, creating the foundation on which customers build and run applications and increasingly demanding AI workloads.
Depending on your project and team, you could contribute to challenges involving cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, system reliability, performance, security, automation, or AI\-enabled engineering experiences.
If you're curious about what happens underneath the cloud and want to understand how software operates at global scale, Azure Core is an extraordinary place to start your engineering career.### **Applications Are Open!**


We encourage interested candidates to **apply as soon as possible**, as **roles are limited** and highly competitive.

  


Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Every day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Learn new engineering technologies, methods, and tools and apply them to your project.
* Seek feedback and use engineering best practices to continuously improve your solutions.

We're particularly interested in students who bring one or more of the following:* Exposure to cloud computing, distributed systems, operating systems, networking, virtualization, or storage through coursework, research, personal projects, hackathons, open source, or previous internships.

jobs.description:
**CIVIL SITE ENGINEER / WORKS SUPERVISOR**

  

  

**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Projects Across Bulgaria**

  

  

**www.group\-egnatia.bg**

  

**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**

  

  

**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**

  

  

Egnatia Bulgaria, part of the Egnatia Group, is an international EPC contractor providing Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) and Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across the energy, infrastructure, telecommunications, industrial, commercial and residential sectors.

  

  

With more than 25 years of presence in Southeast Europe, we deliver technically demanding projects with a strong focus on quality, safety, reliability and engineering excellence.

  

  

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors to join our project teams throughout Bulgaria.

  

  

The position is suitable both for engineers who already have site supervision experience and for motivated professionals who want to further develop their career in construction and project execution within an international EPC environment.

  

  

**The Role**

  

  

You will be responsible for the on\-site supervision and coordination of civil works across a variety of Egnatia Bulgaria projects, including energy and renewable energy projects, infrastructure, industrial facilities, buildings and commercial or residential fit\-outs.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* On\-site supervision of civil construction activities.
* Supervision of earthworks, excavations, grading and site preparation.
* Supervision of concrete works, foundations and structural works.
* Supervision of roads, drainage systems, fencing and associated infrastructure works.
* Supervision of civil and architectural works in building and fit\-out projects, where applicable.
* Coordination and daily follow\-up of subcontractors, site crews and suppliers.
* Verification that works are executed according to drawings, technical specifications and project requirements.
* Monitoring of quantities, productivity, quality and construction progress.
* Identification and reporting of technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordination with Project Managers, engineers, designers and other project disciplines.
* Monitoring compliance with site HSE and quality requirements.
* Preparation of daily/weekly progress updates, site records, photographic documentation and technical reports.

  

  

**Requirements**

  

  

* Degree in Civil Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Previous construction/site experience will be considered an advantage; the level of responsibility will be adapted to the candidate’s experience.
* Good command of English, written and spoken, is required.
* Knowledge of Bulgarian will be considered a strong asset.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings and specifications.
* Good organisational, communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary project team.
* Willingness to work on and travel between project sites throughout Bulgaria.
* Valid Category B driving licence.

  

  

**What We Offer**

  

  

* Net monthly salary: **€1,500–€2,500**, depending on experience, qualifications and level of responsibility.
* Accommodation provided in the vicinity the projects
* Company vehicle according to the requirements of the position.
* Laptop and mobile phone.
* Access to modern site supervision and engineering tools, including surveying GPS equipment, drones and digital reporting tools.
* Continuous training and hands\-on technical development.
* Strong engineering and technical support from experienced project teams.
* Exposure to different types and scales of EPC projects.
* Opportunities for increased responsibility and long\-term career development within the Egnatia Group.

  

  

**Location**

  

  

The position is based on project sites throughout **Bulgaria.** Accommodation and transportation support are provided according to project requirements.

  

  

**Join Our Team**

  

  

If you are interested in developing your career through hands\-on involvement in challenging engineering and construction projects, we would like to hear from you.

  

  

  

**ΕΠΙΒΛΕΠΩΝ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ – ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΟΣ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ (CIVIL SITE ENGINEER)**

  

  

**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Έργα σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία**

  

  

**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**

  

  

**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**

  

  

Η **Egnatia Bulgaria**, μέλος του **Egnatia Group**, είναι διεθνής **EPC Contractor**, παρέχοντας ολοκληρωμένες υπηρεσίες Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC) καθώς και Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) στους τομείς της ενέργειας, των υποδομών, των τηλεπικοινωνιών, των βιομηχανικών, εμπορικών και οικιστικών έργων.

  

  

Με περισσότερα από 25 χρόνια παρουσίας στη Νοτιοανατολική Ευρώπη, υλοποιούμε τεχνικά απαιτητικά έργα με ιδιαίτερη έμφαση στην ποιότητα, την ασφάλεια, την αξιοπιστία και την τεχνική αρτιότητα.

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Jobomschrijving:
**Azure DevOps Engineer**
**CONTEXT**
=====================================


AXA Belgium wil het team **Relationship and Contact Management** versterken met een **Azure DevOps Engineer**.


De digitale wereld is een sterk groeiende markt en AXA wil haar klantgerichte front\-end\- en mobiele applicaties voortdurend verbeteren via robuuste, kostenefficiënte, gestandaardiseerde en geautomatiseerde platformen die een snelle ondersteuning van de business mogelijk maken.


Binnen specifieke domeinen van de onderneming levert het Relationship and Contact Management\-team dagelijks diensten op gedistribueerde infrastructuuroplossingen binnen de ondersteunde technologieën (Azure, .NET, MSSQL, IIS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, enz.), volgens de ITIL\-methodologie en binnen een Agile werkomgeving.


Ervaring met **Microsoft Dynamics 365**, **Dataverse** en het automatiseren van hun levenscyclus via **Azure DevOps** is een belangrijke troef, met name voor het beheer van omgevingen, deployments, integraties, beveiliging en monitoring.


Dankzij een sterk helikopterzicht op complexe situaties past onze toekomstige Azure DevOps Engineer deze oplossingen toe in lijn met de AXA\-strategie, de lokale standaardarchitectuur, de operationele richtlijnen en de SLA's die met de business werden overeengekomen op het vlak van productiviteit, kwaliteit en dienstverlening.

**FUNCTIEBESCHRIJVING**
-----------------------


Als **Senior DevOps Engineer** draag je bij aan de volgende activiteiten:

* Je werkt voornamelijk als **Ops Engineer**, met verantwoordelijkheden inzake automatiseringsscripting en development.
* Je werkt nauw samen met diverse stakeholders (developers, testers, cross\-department SPOC's, offshore teams, enz.).
* Je bent verantwoordelijk voor Application Lifecycle Management, problem management en release management, conform de beveiligingsrichtlijnen van AXA.
* Je neemt ook een **FinOps**\-rol op en bent in staat de kosten van een implementatie te evalueren vóór deze wordt uitgerold.
* Je ondersteunt je team en onderhoudt rechtstreeks contact met verschillende stakeholders.
* Je beheert incidenten, begrijpt de end\-to\-end processen en analyseert stack traces.
* Je staat in voor de dagelijkse **Business\-as\-Usual** activiteiten binnen jouw expertisegebied.
* Je implementeert **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** end\-to\-end.

**JOUW PROFIEL**
----------------

* Je beschikt over een bacheloropleiding in IT of een gelijkwaardige richting.
* Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie en technische omgeving.
* Je bent oplossingsgericht en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden waarmee je snel de juiste oplossingsrichting kunt bepalen.
* Je leert snel, toont leiderschap en kunt zelfstandig werken met een innovatieve en creatieve mindset.
* Je beschikt over een goede kennis van het Engels.

**TECHNISCHE VAARDIGHEDEN**
---------------------------

* .NET\-serverbeheer (IIS / Windows Server)
* Azure\-beheer (IAM / .NET\-gebaseerde applicaties / networking)
* Azure DevOps (Git, CI/CD\-pipelines, IaC/YAML, rechtenbeheer)
* Azure API Management (APIM)
* Azure Data Factory
* Azure ARM Templates
* Azure Cost Management
* PowerShell en de verschillende Azure\-libraries
* Serverbesturingssystemen (Linux en Windows)
* Webserviceconcepten (SOAP, REST, API Management)
* Webservers (IIS, HAProxy, Reverse Proxy)
* Dataintegraties (MSSQL)
* Beveiligingsconcepten (SSL, certificaten, security gateways, hardening van resources)
* Monitoringtools (Dynatrace, Application Insights)
* Netwerkconcepten (LAN, TCP/IP, load balancing, firewallbeheer)
* Troubleshooting\- en debuggingtools (OpenSSL, Postman, netwerktrace\-analyse, Kudu, Dev Tools, enz.)
* Kennis van het SDLC\-proces en de SDA\-tools die binnen AXA worden gebruikt vormt een belangrijke meerwaarde (Octopus).

### **Gewenste Azure\-certificeringen**

* AZ\-900 \- Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* AZ\-204 \- Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure

**FUNCTIONELE EN OPERATIONELE VAARDIGHEDEN**
--------------------------------------------

* Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse en hun architectuur.
* Beheer van omgevingen en deployments tussen Development\-, Test\- en Productieomgevingen.
* Automatisering van de solution lifecycle via Azure DevOps en CI/CD\-processen.
* Integraties met Azure, API Management, SQL en andere systemen.
* Beheer van toegangsrechten, service accounts, certificaten en secrets.
* Monitoring, incidentanalyse en dependency analysis.
* Samenwerking met functionele CRM\-teams en Dynamics 365 Developers.
 *AXA wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de diverse samenleving waarin wij leven en voert daarom al jaren een beleid van actieve diversiteit, non\-discriminatie en gelijke kansen. In dit kader garanderen wij een gelijke behandeling en toegang tot selecties, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, culturele achtergrond, handicap, geslacht of seksuele geaardheid of andere kenmerken*. *Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af.* **AXA Belgium**  

Meer dan 3000 mensen werken bij ons, vanuit onze vooruitstrevende kantoren in Brussel, Antwerpen, Eupen en Luik. We werken samen met 3200 makelaars. We hebben 3 miljoen klanten en zijn nummer 1 in autoverzekeringen. Het is onze ambitie om onze relatie met al onze klanten te transformeren van betaler naar partner om ons echt te onderscheiden. **Onze fundamenten**
Onze belangrijkste leidraad zijn onze waarden: **Customer first, Integrity, Courage** **en** **One AXA**. Alles wat we doen, daar staan we als één team achter.  

Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af. Meer info in ons Diversiteits\- en Inclusiebeleid. **Wat we aanbieden** **Een mooie beloning voor je werk**
Een competitief loon, eventueel aangevuld met discretionaire persoonlijke en collectieve premies en natuurlijk ook maaltijd\- en ecocheques, een volledige terugbetaling van het openbaar vervoer en een cafetariaplan. **Alle voordelen van werken bij een verzekeraar**
Van groepsverzekering tot ambulante en hospitalisatieverzekering (ook gezinsleden kunnen daarbij aansluiten aan een voordelig tarief) en met tot 30% korting op onze andere verzekeringsproducten. **Een job die zich aanpast aan je leven en dromen**
Een flexibel rooster van 35 uur per week, 36 dagen verlof per jaar om op te laden, evenals de mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk van thuis uit te werken.
Wij bieden sportlessen op het werk, welzijnsprogramma's voor werknemers en trainingen, om u in topvorm te houden, zowel fysiek als mentaal.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer – Data Acquisition New
jobs.description:
Ghent, Belgium
  
**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**


At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real\-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.


With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850\+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting\-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.


**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**


We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment


* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together \- we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket\-ship?


**Job Details**


* Engineering
* Belgium \- Ghent
* Full\-Time/Hybrid

**What you will do**


You'll join our Crawler Engineering team as a Backend Engineer focused on data acquisition. This is a building role: you'll design and develop high\-performance systems, mostly in Rust, that collect billions of data points from the web. The work sits where backend engineering meets how the web works: HTTP stacks, proxies and browser tooling. When a data source blocks an approach, you'll dig into what's happening on the wire and find another way forward. You'll also help make our infrastructure "agent\-friendly", so other teams can safely build on it with AI.


**Where you will have impact**
------------------------------


* Design, build and improve backend systems for data acquisition that handle close to 200 million requests a day.
* Work on our in\-house proxy layer and browser tooling: request routing, connection handling and protocol\-level behaviour.
* Investigate hard crawler problems, test alternative approaches when one gets blocked, and turn what works into robust, reusable systems.
* Build clear interfaces and guardrails so other teams and AI agents can use what you build reliably.
* Own the quality of your code, including code written with AI assistance: tests, observability and maintainability.
* Work closely with crawler engineers, DevOps and Security to ship solutions that are secure and scalable.

**About our team**
------------------


The Crawler engineering team makes sure Lighthouse customers get fresh, high\-quality rates, ranking and supply data. We handle close to 200 million requests a day across 200\+ data sources, so the team carries a big responsibility for keeping our crawling infrastructure reliable, efficient and ahead of a web that keeps changing.
**What's in it for you?**


* Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices.
* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work\-life balance.
* Collaborative team: High\-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000\+ users worldwide.
* Mobility options: Mobility budget or company car (based on your job category).
* Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
* Net allowance: to support home office related expenses.
* Vouchers: lunch vouchers \& eco vouchers.
* Comprehensive health insurance: Extensive coverage for you and your dependents.
* Pension funding: Group insurance to secure your future.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**


* You have hands on experience building, deploying and running production backend services in a cloud environment.
* You're experienced with a systems language such as **Rust** or **C/C\+\+**, or you have a strong track record in another backend language and a real drive to go deep in Rust.
* You have a solid grasp of how the web works under the hood: HTTP, TCP/IP, TLS and proxies.
* You have an **R\&D mindset**. You're curious about how browsers and network stacks work internally, you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you'd rather prove a hypothesis than assume it.
* You have strong analytical and debugging skills. You're comfortable with packet captures, profilers and reading other people's source code.
* You communicate clearly, share your opinions, welcome feedback and work well in a team.
* You're fluent in English.

**Technologies you will work with**


Rust, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Claude Code.


**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**


Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.


Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!


**Learn more about our careers and recruitment process** \| **Our company and leadership team** \| **Beware of recruitment scams**

jobs.title: Project Engineer/Scientist - Radiation (SY-STI-BMP-2026-235-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

RADNEXT 2030 is a Horizon Europe Research Infrastructure Services project that provides coordinated transnational access to radiation effects testing facilities across Europe and beyond. CERN is the project coordinator and also operates two key facilities within the network: CHARM and HEARTS@CERN. This position is embedded in the Radiation to Electronics (R2E) activity within the Accelerator Systems department. You will work at the interface between project management, user access operations, and radiation effects research, contributing to the successful delivery of RADNEXT 2030's objectives. You will gain broad exposure to the European radiation hardness assurance community, to CERN's accelerator infrastructure, and to the design, execution and analysis of radiation effects experiments.

**Your responsibilities**

* Contribute to the definition and coordination of the transnational access workflow for facilities within the RADNEXT 2030 framework.
* Contribute to the definition, testing and improvement of the facility access online portal.
* Provide scientific support to the organisation and delivery of RADNEXT 2030 consortium activities.
* Support the scientific communication, dissemination and outreach activities of RADNEXT 2030\.
* Contribute to applied research tasks, with a focus on novel testing techniques and radiation environment characterisation.
* Support the integration of the HEARTS@CERN facility and its related user management into the RADNEXT 2030 consortium.
* Engage with the broader radiation effects community through the RADNEXT 2030 user base, supporting training activities including the Radiation Effects Testing Summer School.


More information here: https://radnext.web.cern.ch/

**Your profile**

* Some familiarity with radiation effects testing and radiation hardness assurance, gained through studies, a thesis, internships or professional experience.
* Initial experience in the design, preparation or execution of irradiation experiments would be an advantage.
* Some experience in scientific writing and presenting results, for example through a thesis, reports or conference contributions.
* Familiarity with project coordination, user support or scientific service activities would be an advantage.


Skills

* Basic knowledge of radiation effects in electronics; familiarity with the main radiation test standards and methodologies (e.g. ESA/ECSS, MIL\-STD) would be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of particle accelerator facilities and radiation\-matter interaction physics relevant to radiation effects testing.
* Ability to work in an international, multi\-institutional project environment and to interact with a diverse user community.
* Good organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with appropriate guidance.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Applied Physics, Electronics Engineering (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  

**Additional Information**  

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-November\-2026


This position involves:

* Work in Radiation Areas.
* Stand\-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
* Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.


Job reference: SY\-STI\-BMP\-2026\-235\-GRAE


Field of work: Applied Physics


Benchmark job: 200140 \- Applied Physicist

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.description:

? **¿Fullstack, Platform Engineering, Cloud y Developer Experience en una misma posición?**


Desde **Q\-tech** estamos colaborando con una gran compañía tecnológica internacional para incorporar un/a **Platform Fullstack Engineer** a su hub tecnológico de **Barcelona**.


Pero ojo: no buscamos simplemente a alguien que haga frontend \+ backend.


? Buscamos un perfil con verdadera mentalidad de **Platform Engineering**.


Alguien que entienda que su "usuario" también son los propios developers y que disfrute creando herramientas, APIs, automatizaciones y soluciones **self\-service** que permitan a otros equipos trabajar con mayor autonomía y menos fricción.


? **¿Con qué trabajarás?**


? **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Next.js y arquitecturas Micro\-Frontend
  

? **Backend:** .NET Core / C\# \+ Node.js (NestJS / Express)
  

? **APIs:** REST, resilience patterns, OAuth2 / OIDC
  

? **Containers:** Docker \+ Kubernetes
  

? **CI/CD \& GitOps:** pipelines, testing, registries y ArgoCD
  

? **Cloud:** entornos Multicloud / GCP
  

? **IaC:** Terraform
  

? **Observability:** OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, K6
  

? **Platform tooling:** Backstage, Feature Flags, developer portals y boilerplates
  

? **AI\-assisted development:** Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, agentes y nuevas formas de automatizar tareas de desarrollo

Nos interesa especialmente alguien **hands\-on y pragmático**, capaz de moverse entre frontend, backend e infraestructura y, sobre todo, que entienda el propósito de Platform Engineering: **hacer que otros equipos de desarrollo puedan trabajar mejor.**

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.  



  

**Job Title** : Software Automation Test Engineer  



  

**Job Description Summary**  

We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer who will help us further develop and maintain our test automation framework.


The framework is already actively developed and has a strong technical foundation. We are looking for someone who can bring additional experience, ideas and engineering perspective to the area and work closely with the current owner to drive it further.  



  

**What we are looking for:**

* Strong experience in test automation and automation framework development
* Strong C\# / .NET skills
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright or similar modern browser automation frameworks
* Good experience with API and integration testing
* Good understanding of test architecture and different testing levels — Unit/Integration, Endpoint/API, Frontend and E2E
* Experience with Azure DevOps
* Experience with BDD and data\-driven testing
* Ability to work with complex systems, configurations, test environments and test data
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
* AI\-oriented mindset — practical experience with AI\-assisted development and genuine interest in exploring how AI can improve test automation, maintenance, failure analysis and testing workflows
* Strong ownership and initiative — not only implementing requested tests, but identifying problems, proposing improvements and following them through
* Curiosity and willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively
* Comfortable with technically challenging problems and areas where the solution is not yet obvious
Good collaboration skills — able to work closely with the current framework owner, developers and other engineers  
* 

  

**Preferred Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mathematics, IT, Physics, or related fields (IT preferred).
* At least 4 years of experience in QA, with 2\+ years in test automation.
At least 2 years of experience testing web or desktop applications.  
* 

  

**Required Skills**

*Technical Skills:*

* Programming skills in any object\-oriented language and a willingness to switch to C\#.
* Knowledge of common principles of testing and test automation framework design.
* Familiarity with Playwright or Cypress for C\# UI automation (optional).
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (optional).

*Soft Skills:*

* Strong problem\-solving and bug\-identification skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues.
* Results\-oriented mindset with attention to detail.
* Clear, structured communication skills.
* Team player with system thinking and an Agile/Scrum mindset.

*Language Skills:*

English: Upper\-intermediate level or higher.  

* 

  

**What We Offer**

At our company, we are on a mission to create a better and healthier world. By rapidly expanding our medical software teams, we are driving innovation in 3D planning and 3D printing technologies to make advanced, personalized care accessible to more patients—at a more affordable price.


Joining our team means becoming part of a forward\-thinking organization that values impact, collaboration, and excellence. Here’s what we offer:  



  

* **Purpose\-Driven Work** : Be part of a team that’s transforming healthcare by empowering surgeons and improving patient outcomes with cutting\-edge 3D technologies.
* **Hybrid Work Policy** : Enjoy the flexibility of working from home up to three days a week while staying connected to your team at the office at least two days per week.
* **A Growing Environment** : Work in a dynamic, rapidly expanding team where innovation and personal growth are encouraged.
* **Collaborative Culture** : Join a supportive, diverse team of experts passionate about making a tangible difference in the medical field.
* **Professional Development** : Opportunities to grow your skills and expertise while working with the latest technologies in medical software.

Together, we’re shaping the future of personalized medicine—one patient at a time.  



  

**What’s waiting for you**

**Work that matters**  

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.


At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.  



**A people\-centered space**  

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.


At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.  



**An environment of trust**  

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.


At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.  



**A career ready to build**  

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.


At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.  



  

Make a difference together with the Medical team.

In a context, we are looking for a Developer responsible for the development, configuration, integration and operational support of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions within an international environment.
Main responsibilities:


* Provide **L1/L2 support** for IAM incidents, service requests, and technical issues.
* Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, MFA, token, directory, and integration issues.
* Design and configure **PingFederate** authentication and onboarding flows.
* Work with **PingOne MFA**, implementing and troubleshooting authentication methods such as **FIDO2, OTP/TOTP, Push and SMS**.

* HTML basic undertanding.
* Implement and support **OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect**, PKCE, JWT, JWKS and token introspection/revocation.
* Manage **identity provisioning and deprovisioning** and identity data flows.
* Analyze logs, traces, and API requests/responses to identify root causes.
* Collaborate with application, security, infrastructure and vendor teams across multiple European markets.
* Create technical documentation and participate in Agile methodologies and incident/change management.

IT Tools


* PingFederate, PingOne, PingDirectory, PingDirectory Proxy.
* OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, PKCE, JWT, JWKS.
* MFA: **FIDO2, Push, OTP/TOTP, SMS.**
* Identity Lifecycle, Provisioning \& Deprovisioning.
* LDAP, REST APIs, SCIM, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* **Git/GitLab**, Docker, Ansible, Bruno.

Profile:


* Hands\-on experience in **IAM / Ping Identity** technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with L1/L2 operational experience.
* Experience across development, project implementation, and production support activities.
* **Fluent professional English** and experience working with international teams.
  

  

Skills


BUSINESS


* Knowledge of banking and banking processes will be an asset.
* Business logic knowledge and IT Relations.

TRANSVERSAL SKILLS


* Experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

BEHAVIORAL SKILLS


* Ability to understand, explain, and support solution evolutions.
* Ability to meet objectives / Result orientation.
* With attention to detail/ Rigorous.
* Collaboration and teamwork.
* Problem/incident resolution.
* Client focused.
* Effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Proactivity.

LANGUAGES


English level B2 or higher.
  

  

Benefits:
  

* Training programs, career plans and internal mobility opportunities, national and international thanks to our presence in different countries.
* Diversity and Inclusion Committee that ensures an inclusive work environment. In recent years, several employee communities have been created to organize diversity and inclusion awareness actions (PRIDE, We Generations and MixCity).
* Corporate volunteering program (1 Million Hours 2 Help) in which employees can dedicate time out of their working hours to volunteer activities.
* Flexible compensation plan
* Hybrid telecommuting model (50%)
* 31 vacation days.

  

Diversity and Inclusion commitment
  

  

BNP Paribas Group in Spain is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We are proud to create, maintain, and develop strategic business applications for BNP Paribas Personal Finance entities worldwide, maintaining high service levels and delivering added value to our customers.
