jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer · AI & Agentic Development
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer · AI \& Agentic Development

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con sólida experiencia en desarrollo web, mobile y cloud, y especial interés en la aplicación de IA y agentes al proceso de desarrollo de software.

Funciones:

Desarrollo y evolución de aplicaciones Web con React y aplicaciones mobile con React Native, junto con APIs y servicios backend. Diseño e implementación de arquitecturas cloud sobre AWS, especialmente Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, EC2 y CloudWatch, además de otros servicios habituales de AWS.

Participación en todo el ciclo de desarrollo, incluyendo arquitectura, programación, integración, testing automatizado, CI/CD, revisión y calidad del código.

Se busca experiencia o interés avanzado en AI\-assisted Development / Agentic Coding, utilizando herramientas como Claude Code, Cursor, Codex u otras equivalentes. Se valorará especialmente la capacidad para orquestar varios agentes especializados en análisis, programación, testing, revisión, documentación y refactoring, integrándolos en un proceso de desarrollo controlado y automatizado.

Perfil técnico:

Experiencia senior en React, React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs REST, Git y testing automatizado, así como experiencia práctica en AWS y conocimientos de arquitectura, seguridad, escalabilidad y CI/CD.

Se valorará experiencia con herramientas como Jest/Vitest, Playwright/Cypress, React Testing Library, AWS SAM/CDK/CloudFormation y sistemas de automatización y calidad de código.

Se valorará adicionalmente:

Experiencia en Unity/C\#, Unreal Engine, 3D, XR o desarrollo interactivo.

Formación:

Preferiblemente Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería del Software o equivalente. Se valorará disponer de Máster universitario en desarrollo de software/ingeniería informática y especialmente formación de posgrado o Máster oficial en Inteligencia Artificial, así como titulaciones de experto o especializaciones acreditadas en IA aplicada al desarrollo, LLMs o sistemas multiagente.

Buscamos:

Un perfil con autonomía y capacidad de decisión técnica, orientación a la calidad, pensamiento crítico y capacidad para utilizar la IA como parte integral del proceso de ingeniería, no únicamente como herramienta de generación de código.

Sueldo: 28\.000,00€\-32\.000,00€ al año

Beneficios:

* Flexibilidad horaria
* Jornada intensiva en verano
* Jornada intensiva los viernes

Ubicación del trabajo: Empleo remoto

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a de Software – ERP e Integraciones
jobs.description:
En **Recambios Frain** buscamos incorporar una persona al equipo de IT para ayudarnos a avanzar en nuevos desarrollos, mejorar aplicaciones que ya tenemos y participar en proyectos relacionados con ERP, logística, gestión interna y comercio B2B.

No buscamos necesariamente a alguien que domine todas las tecnologías que utilizamos. Buscamos una persona con experiencia en desarrollo, resolutiva y con capacidad para entender un negocio real y convertir necesidades en soluciones.

**¿En qué trabajarás?**

* Desarrollo y mejora de aplicaciones internas y aplicaciones web.
* Integraciones entre nuestros diferentes sistemas, ERP, SGA y otras herramientas.
* Automatización y mejora de procesos.
* Trabajo con bases de datos y optimización de consultas y procesos.
* Evolución y modernización de aplicaciones existentes.
* Uso de herramientas de IA como apoyo al desarrollo, análisis, documentación y automatización.

**¿Qué buscamos?**

Nos interesa especialmente experiencia en algunas de estas tecnologías o entornos:

* PHP y/o Python.
* SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
* Integraciones mediante APIs.
* ERP, SGA, Odoo o aplicaciones de gestión empresarial.
* .NET.
* Progress / OpenEdge.

No es necesario dominar todo lo anterior. Valoraremos especialmente que tengas una buena base técnica, autonomía, capacidad para aprender y experiencia trabajando sobre aplicaciones reales en producción.

**El puesto** 

La idea no es desarrollar software aislado del negocio. Trabajarás directamente sobre procesos que utilizan diariamente diferentes áreas de una empresa de más de 160 personas: logística, almacén, compras, ventas, administración, e\-commerce, etc.

Tenemos muchos proyectos pendientes y buscamos alguien que pueda incorporarse al equipo, aportar experiencia y asumir progresivamente proyectos propios.

Si estás interesado/a envíanos tu currículum para que podamos contactarte y entrar en más detalle sobre las condiciones de la vacante.

Ubicación del trabajo: Empleo presencial

jobs.title: Senior Playable Ads Programmer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

**Role Summary:**



We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Playable Programmer / Creative Technical Artist to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us create high\-performing playable ads and creative content for our mobile games.



This is a **fully remote position open to candidates from any location**, with availability to work in alignment with our Saudi Arabia working schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM KSA time).



The role combines technical development and creative production, using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies to build, iterate, and optimize interactive playable experiences and performance\-focused video creatives.



Working closely with AI Engineering, Design, Marketing, UA, Product, Art, and Engineering, you'll be part of a fast\-paced environment where rapid experimentation, high\-volume testing, and iteration are a big part of how we work.



You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our internal creative production and AI\-assisted tools and workflows, helping us find faster and more scalable ways to produce and test creatives.


### **Responsibilities**


**Playable Development \& Prototyping**


* Develop and maintain playable ads and gameplay prototypes using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies
* Build responsive gameplay interactions, UI flows, animations, visual feedback, and creative effects
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay and interactive creative concepts
* Build reusable gameplay systems, modular templates, components, and scalable architectures
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code where applicable
* Optimize playables for performance, loading time, file size, and cross\-device/platform compatibility


**Creative Production \& Performance**


* Create and iterate on video advertising creatives, gameplay\-based videos, and performance marketing assets
* Produce a high volume of playable and video creative variations for testing
* Iterate on creatives based on testing results, analytics, and UA performance
* Experiment with different gameplay concepts, creative formats, hooks, interactions, and technical approaches
* Support debugging, testing, analytics integrations, creative validation, and quality control


**AI, Tools \& Automation**


* Collaborate with AI Engineers on AI\-generated playable, video creative, and automation workflows
* Help develop, test, validate, and improve internal tools used for playable and creative production
* Explore AI\-assisted development and creative production workflows
* Experiment with new tools, engines, technologies, and approaches that can improve the speed and scale of creative production


**Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, UA, Product, Design, Art, AI, and Engineering teams
* Translate creative concepts into technically feasible and engaging playable experiences
* Collaborate on creative testing and iteration based on performance data and learnings
* Contribute ideas and technical solutions throughout the creative development process

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building polished, responsive, and technically reliable playable ads
* Producing and iterating on playable and video creatives quickly and at high volume
* Creating reusable systems and templates that make creative production faster and more scalable
* Delivering playables that meet performance, loading time, file size, and platform requirements
* Using creative performance data and testing results to continuously improve concepts and execution
* Combining strong technical implementation with creative thinking and experimentation
* Contributing to AI\-assisted tools and workflows that improve creative production
* Collaborating effectively across creative, technical, product, and UA teams
* Taking strong ownership of creative concepts from prototype through testing and iteration

### **Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of experience in Unity game development, technical art, creative development, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Unity and C\# and/or JavaScript
* Experience building gameplay systems, prototypes, playable ads, or interactive advertising experiences
* Strong understanding of mobile optimization, performance, and technical constraints
* Ability to combine technical implementation with creative thinking and fast prototyping
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative, and performance\-driven environment

### **Bonus Points For**


* Experience with Luna Playable and playable ad platforms such as AppLovin, Unity Ads, Meta, or Google
* Experience creating playable ads, hypercasual/hybrid\-casual prototypes, or video creatives for mobile game UA
* Experience with motion graphics, animation, VFX, shaders, or technical art, using tools such as After Effects, Blender, or Unity Timeline
* Experience with AI\-assisted creative production, automation tools, or workflows
* A portfolio, GitHub, playable examples, or video creatives demonstrating relevant work


If this role excites you and you're ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer for Lab Connectivity
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action \- we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non\-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R Departments at Roche Diagnostics.
  
  

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.
  
  

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.
  
  

You will be responsible
  
  

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

* Healthcare Interoperability\& Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1\-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments.
* Software Development\& Quality Practices: Proven hands\-on C\# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object\-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code.
* End\-to\-End Ownership\& AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies.
* Technical Leadership\& Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders.
* Education, Communication\& Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's \+ 6 years or Master's \+ 4 years), with strong problem\-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross\-functional collaboration.


Locations
  
  

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.
  
  

Leadership Skills
  
You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.
  
  

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams usethese skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.
  
  

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:
  
  

* Put patients first
* Follow the science
* Act as one team
* Embrace differences
* Accelerate learning
* Simplify radically
* Make impact now
* Think long term


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

jobs.title: IT Integration Senior Developer
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------



El *IT Integration Senior Developer* será responsable del diseño, implementación y soporte de integraciones para las plataformas de *Broking*. Este rol trabajará estrechamente con los analistas de negocio para aplicar las soluciones definidas, garantizando la estabilidad, eficiencia y rendimiento de las integraciones actuales y futuras. Además, será clave en la identificación de mejoras y en la resolución de incidentes técnicos.

  


**Responsabilidades Principales**


**Diseño e Implementación**


* Diseñar las integraciones entre las plataformas de *brokerage* y otros sistemas existentes.
* Desarrollar y mantener los componentes personalizados en las plataformas de *brokerage*.
* Asegurar que las soluciones se construyen siguiendo patrones y buenas prácticas de desarrollo e integración.

  


**Mejora Continua**


* Proponer mejoras en integraciones y aplicaciones que contribuyan a los objetivos del negocio.
* Analizar y detectar el origen de incidentes, aplicando las soluciones correspondientes para garantizar la estabilidad operativa.

  


**Documentación y Calidad**


* Elaborar y mantener documentación técnica clara y completa.
* Realizar y supervisar pruebas integradas para asegurar un funcionamiento correcto y estable.
**Qualifications**
------------------



**Requisitos del Puesto**


**Formación y Conocimientos Técnicos**


* Conocimiento demostrable del negocio asegurador.
* Experiencia en integraciones entre aplicaciones y entornos diversos.
* Mínimo **5 años de experiencia** en:
	+ Desarrollo en plataforma **.NET**: C\#, ASP.NET, Angular, JavaScript.
	+ **SQL Server** a nivel de programación (T\-SQL).
	+ Herramientas de reporting (**Reporting Services**).
	+ Servicios de integración (**SSIS**).
  


**Competencias Profesionales**


* Capacidad para generar documentación técnica y ejecutar pruebas integradas.
* Habilidades de organización y planificación.
* Buenas habilidades de comunicación y relación interpersonal.
* **Inglés hablado y escrito a buen nivel.**
* Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

  


*We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers , from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidate.helpdesk@willistowerswatson.com.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content.

**The role you'll play**


We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer\-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one.


The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows.

**The team you'll be a part of**


You'll be one of the founding members of a brand\-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set.

**If you want to make a difference, make it with us by...**

* Developing and maintaining applications, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and databases
* Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements
* Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation
* Ensuring high\-quality software through active participation in code reviews
* Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand\-ups, and other team processes
* Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests
* Leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor
* Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams
* Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings
* Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations

**In one year, you'll know you were successful if...**

* You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships.
* You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge\-sharing team atmosphere.
* You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact.
* You share your expertise by mentoring mid\-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed.
* You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision\-making.

**Desired Experience And Competencies**

**What does it take to work for LanguageWire?**

**What you'll need to bring**

* Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices.
* Extensive experience with C\# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6\+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.)
* Experience with Python
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration
* Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET
* Responsible for front\-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full\-stack and frontend developers
* Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar).
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices
* Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end).
* Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring
* Ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional teams, including product, design, and QA.
* DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

**This will make you stand out**

* Knowledge of microservices architecture and event\-driven systems
* Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL
* Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ
* Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus)
* Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation)
* Awareness of security best practices in software development
* Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge\-sharing within the team

**Our perks**

* Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas
* Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture
* International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia
* We take care of our people and initiate many social get\-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!
* 150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments
* Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square
* Private health insurance
* We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.
* Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities
* A dog friendly atmosphere
* Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.
* Social area and game room (foosball table, darts, and board games)
* Bike and car parking

  



**About LanguageWire**
At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people \& businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.  



**Our values drive our behavior**

**We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.**

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We care and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback, and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.

  



**Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:**


"Once the purpose \& values project had been rolled out, I felt a stronger connection and more engaged. Within our team, we care for each other, help each other on tasks, projects and we value different opinions. We truly lift each other up to be our best and ambitiously strive towards constantly improving on a professional and personal level."


(Arpi, Application Support Team Lead, Valencia)

  



**Yes, to diversity, equity \& inclusion**

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.


LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.

  



Want to know more?


We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!


If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our *website!*

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer (IR-551)
jobs.description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007\. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe.We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid\-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley\-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net/


We are developing a modern ERP platform designed to digitize end\-to\-end communication and operational workflows across the dental healthcare sector. The solution connects clinical practices with specialized service providers, streamlining order tracking, custom product fulfillment, and secure digital asset exchange.


As a Senior Java Developer, you will lead backend engineering efforts to build scalable, high\-availability services that manage dynamic workflow states, business\-critical integrations, and high\-volume transaction data.

 **Requirements**  

* 5\+ Years of Experience: Solid background in core backend software development using Java (11/17\+).
* Spring Ecosystem Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of Spring Boot 3, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Spring Web.
* Relational Databases: Strong relational data modeling and SQL performance tuning skills (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
* API Design \& Security: Proven ability to build RESTful APIs, manage OAuth2/JWT authentication, and design clean interface contracts.
* Architectural Foundations: Experience with microservices, domain\-driven design concepts, and transactional state management.
* Testing \& CI/CD: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and containerization tools (Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

**Nice\-to\-have:**

* Healthcare / MedTech Exposure: General familiarity with health\-tech software requirements, data privacy standards, or digital medical record workflows.
* Asynchronous Messaging: Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka or RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing.
* Cloud \& Large File Management: Familiarity with AWS/GCP.
* Caching \& Search: Hands\-on experience with Redis, Elasticsearch, or distributed caching systems.
* Monitoring \& Observability: Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, or central logging tools (ELK stack) for microservice monitoring.

**Responsibilities:**

* Backend Architecture: Architect, implement, and maintain scalable architecture and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring.
* Workflow Engine Design: Engineer reliable backend services to manage multi\-step business logic, status lifecycles, and event\-driven notifications.
* Integration \& Security: Design secure interfaces to connect internal modules with external systems, ensuring strict adherence to healthcare data privacy principles.
* Performance \& Data Storage: Optimize relational database schemas and query performance.
* Code Quality \& Leadership: Enforce software engineering best practices through code reviews, automated testing (unit/integration), and technical mentoring.

  

**Benefits**  

* Awesome projects with an impact
* Udemy courses of your choice
* Team\-buildings, events, marathons \& charity activities to connect and recharge
* Workshops, trainings, expert knowledge\-sharing that keep you growing
* Clear career path
* Absence days for work\-life balance
* Flexible hours \& work setup \- work from anywhere and organize your day your way

jobs.description:
1️⃣ About the job
  

2️⃣ Key responsibilities
  

3️⃣ Profiles \& Skills
  

4️⃣ Why join BNP Paribas?  




**ABOUT THE JOB**
-----------------


As a Full Stack Developer, you will design and maintain responsive web applications to support operational security solutions. You will work within our Production Security service to ensure the efficient control of network, server, and endpoint infrastructures.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------


* Design and develop responsive web applications using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
* Implement UI components, state management, and routing while ensuring accessibility (WCAG).
* Integrate RESTful or GraphQL APIs by collaborating with back\-end teams to define technical contracts.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in regular code reviews.
* Contribute to back\-end services using .NET Core or other stacks when required.
* Mentor junior developers and share front\-end best practices within the team.

**PROFILE \& SKILLS**
---------------------


**Education \& Experience**


* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field.
* You have at least 3 years of professional experience in front\-end development.

**Technical Skills**


* You are proficient in at least one major front\-end framework, preferably React.
* You have a strong command of JavaScript/TypeScript, ES6\+, and modern build tools.
* You have a solid understanding of HTML5 semantics and CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, Sass/Less).
* You are experienced with Git and collaborative CI/CD workflows.
* You can write unit and integration tests using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.

**Preferred Skills**


* You have hands\-on experience with .NET Core/ASP.NET Web API (C\#).
* You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes.
* You have knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* You have experience with GraphQL or real\-time technologies like WebSockets.

**Languages \& Soft Skills**


* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* You have strong problem\-solving skills and high attention to detail.
* You demonstrate effective communication and teamwork abilities.

**️**
-----


**WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS?**
-------------------------


We are BNP Paribas, a leading international bank present in 64 countries. We support our clients through financing, investment, savings, and insurance services, maintaining key positions in Corporate \& Institutional Banking.


In our Spain IT Production area, we ensure the reliability and security of the technological backbone that powers our financial services. We focus on delivering excellence in operational stability.


**OUR PERKS**


* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Flexible working arrangements.
* International and multicultural work environment.
* Strong commitment to diversity and inclusion.

https://group.bnpparibas/en/our\-commitments/inclusion/diversity\-equality\-and\-inclusion


**Ready to make a difference? APPLY NOW!**
------------------------------------------


**Next steps: How does our recruitment process work?**


* We will assess the knowledge and experience highlighted in your CV to validate your fit for the role.


* The Human Resources team will contact you to confirm key details about the position.


* After this initial contact, interviews will be conducted with the relevant business area.


* We will get in touch with you to communicate the final decision of the process.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
**About Us**


At **Nextlane**, we don’t just develop software solutions – we **create the future** of the automotive industry.


We are a company that combines **advanced technology** with a clear vision: **simplifying and digitizing** every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.


We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to **develop** and contribute to meaningful solutions.


So… What does it mean to be a \#Nextlaner?

* Be part of a **g**rowth\-oriented culture.
* Collaborate with **colleagues from all over the world.**
* Believe in **the P**ower of ideas and the **diversity of thought**.
* Be committed to provide an environment where you can **learn, grow, and collaborate** on projects that make a global impact.


Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.


At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to **innovate**, **push boundaries**, and **work on solutions that are transforming** the automotive world.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Own the design, development, and delivery of complex features and systems across our applications.

* Build scalable, maintainable, and high\-quality solutions using .Net and React/Next.
* Drive technical decisions, balancing business needs, delivery timelines, performance, and long\-term maintainability.
* Contribute to the evolution of our backend and frontend architecture, development practices, and engineering standards.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver outstanding user experiences.
* Lead complex functionalities and ensure applications remain reliable, secure, and performant.
* Define and improve testing, release, and quality practices to ensure safe and predictable delivery.
* Identify technical risks early and propose solutions that reduce complexity and support future growth.
* Lead refactoring and modernization initiatives that improve the health of the codebase.
* Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Act as a technical leader within the team, driving engineering excellence and helping raise the overall quality of our mobile platform.
**What We're Looking For:**

* Experience: 6\-8\+ years

* Languages**: English B2/C1**
* Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written ability to influence technical decisions constructively.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including architecture, design patterns, testing, and system design.
* Proven ability to deliver complex features with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.
* Experience making architectural decisions and evaluating technical trade\-offs.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity in complex systems.
* A quality\-focused mindset with experience improving engineering practices and development processes.
* Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively within cross\-functional teams.
* A quality\-focused mindset with experience improving engineering practices and development processes.
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong professional experience developing **backend services with .Net.**
* Good experience developing **frontend application on React/Next**
* Proven experience building, maintaining, and scaling production applications
* Strong understanding of code architecture, design patterns, state management, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization. Understanding clean architecture and SOLID principles.
* Experience designing and implementing automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, and UI tests.
* Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and mobile release processes.
* Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including code quality, maintainability, security, and observability.
* Experience working with Git\-based development workflows and collaborative engineering practices.
* Familiarity with analytics, performance monitoring, and feature flagging solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade\-offs and contribute to architectural decisions across the mobile platform.
**Our Recruitment Process:**

* **Call** with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
* Technical Test
* Technical Interview
* Soft Skill interview with Hiring Manager

 **What We Offer:**


We understand that **flexibility and trust** are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* **Hybrid Work:** Rotational model, 2 days onsite, three days remote.
* **Annual Payments:** 14 payments per year (12 monthly payments \+ 1 summer bonus \+ 1 Christmas bonus in November).
* ️ **Meal Voucher:** €10\.20 per working day.
* **Vacation:** 23 vacation days, plus 24th or 31st December off.
* ️ **Language Training:** Access to group classes in Spanish, English, or French.
* ️ **Private Medical Insurance:** Multicare coverage.
* **Teambuilding:** Join us for memorable afterworks and team activities!

**Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging**


At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where **everyone feels valued and respected**. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

* **Support for people with disabilities**. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
* **Equal opportunities for all:** We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Join **Nextlane** and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.


Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

jobs.title: Senior Playable Ads Programmer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

**Role Summary:**



We're looking for a **Mid\-Senior Playable Programmer / Creative Technical Artist to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us create high\-performing playable ads and creative content for our mobile games.



This is a **fully remote position open to candidates from any location**, with availability to work in alignment with our Saudi Arabia working schedule (Sunday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM KSA time).



The role combines technical development and creative production, using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies to build, iterate, and optimize interactive playable experiences and performance\-focused video creatives.



Working closely with AI Engineering, Design, Marketing, UA, Product, Art, and Engineering, you'll be part of a fast\-paced environment where rapid experimentation, high\-volume testing, and iteration are a big part of how we work.



You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to our internal creative production and AI\-assisted tools and workflows, helping us find faster and more scalable ways to produce and test creatives.


### **Responsibilities**


**Playable Development \& Prototyping**


* Develop and maintain playable ads and gameplay prototypes using Unity, C\#, Luna Playable, and other relevant technologies
* Build responsive gameplay interactions, UI flows, animations, visual feedback, and creative effects
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on gameplay and interactive creative concepts
* Build reusable gameplay systems, modular templates, components, and scalable architectures
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code where applicable
* Optimize playables for performance, loading time, file size, and cross\-device/platform compatibility


**Creative Production \& Performance**


* Create and iterate on video advertising creatives, gameplay\-based videos, and performance marketing assets
* Produce a high volume of playable and video creative variations for testing
* Iterate on creatives based on testing results, analytics, and UA performance
* Experiment with different gameplay concepts, creative formats, hooks, interactions, and technical approaches
* Support debugging, testing, analytics integrations, creative validation, and quality control


**AI, Tools \& Automation**


* Collaborate with AI Engineers on AI\-generated playable, video creative, and automation workflows
* Help develop, test, validate, and improve internal tools used for playable and creative production
* Explore AI\-assisted development and creative production workflows
* Experiment with new tools, engines, technologies, and approaches that can improve the speed and scale of creative production


**Collaboration**


* Work closely with Marketing, UA, Product, Design, Art, AI, and Engineering teams
* Translate creative concepts into technically feasible and engaging playable experiences
* Collaborate on creative testing and iteration based on performance data and learnings
* Contribute ideas and technical solutions throughout the creative development process

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building polished, responsive, and technically reliable playable ads
* Producing and iterating on playable and video creatives quickly and at high volume
* Creating reusable systems and templates that make creative production faster and more scalable
* Delivering playables that meet performance, loading time, file size, and platform requirements
* Using creative performance data and testing results to continuously improve concepts and execution
* Combining strong technical implementation with creative thinking and experimentation
* Contributing to AI\-assisted tools and workflows that improve creative production
* Collaborating effectively across creative, technical, product, and UA teams
* Taking strong ownership of creative concepts from prototype through testing and iteration

### **Qualifications**


* 4\+ years of experience in Unity game development, technical art, creative development, or a related field
* Strong proficiency in Unity and C\# and/or JavaScript
* Experience building gameplay systems, prototypes, playable ads, or interactive advertising experiences
* Strong understanding of mobile optimization, performance, and technical constraints
* Ability to combine technical implementation with creative thinking and fast prototyping
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative, and performance\-driven environment

### **Bonus Points For**

You’re motivated to stay current with emerging capabilities, trends, best practices, and security considerations that can improve the roadmap and team outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Adviser - Business Solutions Engineer (Investment Services) (m/f/d) (2729)
jobs.description:
**Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg**  

  

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.
  

  

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg
### **Job Description**


**We are looking for a Business Solutions Engineer for our Investment Services field**



Our Investment Services team is developing an internal platform that supports the management of cross\-border fund registrations and regulatory operations. The platform is developed directly with the business teams who use it daily.



We are looking for a business solutions engineer who enjoys working within a business team, understanding operational needs and translating them into practical digital solutions. This is not a traditional IT delivery role: you will work closely with fund regulatory specialists and contribute to both product decisions and technical implementation.

### **What you will be working on**


* Continue the design and development of the platform.
* Work directly with business users to understand processes, identify pain points and define appropriate solutions.
* Translate regulatory and operational requirements into maintainable product features.
* Develop workflows for fund registrations, regulatory filings, publications, billing and client reporting.
* Build and improve front end interfaces for operational teams.
* Develop backend services, APIs and business logic using C\# and .NET.
* Design data models and queries.
* Develop document generation, classification and processing capabilities.
* Contribute to AI\-assisted features using Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services.
* Write automated tests and participate in testing with business users.
* Support the transition of new features into daily operational use.
### **What we look for**


* At least 3 to 5 years of professional software development experience, preferably on business\-critical web applications.
* Proven experience developing full\-stack solutions with C\#, .NET, ASP.NET and SQL.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with business users and translating operational requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience maintaining and extending an existing application, including understanding unfamiliar code and improving it incrementally.
* Practical experience with data modelling, system integrations, APIs and structured\-data processing.
* Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot.
* Experience applying software engineering practices such as source control, code reviews and automated testing.
* Experience with Azure or AI services is an advantage.
* Experience in investment funds, financial services, regulatory reporting or workflow automation is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with Apache Spark is an advantage.

**What you will get**  

  

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well\-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.
  

  

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year\-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.
  

  

**Join our next generation**  

**Apply now to start your recruitment journey at KPMG Luxembourg!**
  

  

**\#FindYourPurposeAtKPMG \#TeamBlue**
  

  

By submitting your resume and application information, you authorize KPMG to transmit and store your information in the KPMG recruitment database, and to circulate that information as necessary for the purpose of evaluating your qualifications for this or other job vacancies.
  

  

KPMG is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. Our recruiting decisions are based on your experience and skills.

new_jobs.title: Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

We are seeking for an Automation Engineer to support and further develop our laboratory automation environment. Working closely with our screening and assay scientists, you will implement robust automated workflows and keep our integrated systems running reliably.
The work ranges from day\-to\-day troubleshooting to evaluating new technologies.
Responsibilities:
* Implement, optimize and maintain automated workflows for screening and assay execution, including high\-throughput workflows in 384\- and 1536\-well formats.
* Program and configure automation, scheduling and instrument software, and develop C\# and Python scripts to support automation workflows and system integration.
* Integrate third\-party instruments into automated platforms.
* Support reliable connectivity and data flow between instruments, schedulers and LIMS.
* Maintain, troubleshoot and repair standalone and integrated automation equipment, coordinating vendor service where needed.
* Improve robotic scheduling, equipment utilization and overall workflow reliability.
* Evaluate new technologies through rapid prototyping, testing and implementation.
* Partner with screening teams to transfer established protocols onto automated platforms


Qualifications:
* 5\+ years of experience in laboratory automation, including automation support in a drug discovery environment.
* Hands\-on experience with robotics, integrated automation systems and a broad range of plate\-based instrumentation.
* Proven experience with HighRes Biosolutions automation systems and strong working knowledge of Cellario scheduling software.
* Experience with common liquid handling platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Tecan, Biomek, Bravo) and dispensing technologies (e.g. Combi, Tempest, Certus Flex and Echo acoustic dispensers).
* Advanced programming skills in C\# and Python, plus experience with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Proven troubleshooting ability across instruments, software and system communication.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including working with equipment vendors and external support teams.
* Working knowledge of additional scheduling platforms such as Green Button Go, Momentum, VWorks, DART or SAMI.
* Experience with LIMS and compound management platforms such as Mosaic or comparable systems.
* Familiarity with detection systems such as PHERAstar, high\-content imagers and qPCR instruments.
* Understanding of biochemical, biophysical and cell\-based assays, including technologies such as fluorescence, HTRF, AlphaLISA or NanoBRET.

new_jobs.title: Sales Executive (m/w/d) – New Business für Custom Software
new_jobs.description:
Werde Teil des doubleSlash Teams
  

### **Sales Executive (m/w/d) – New Business für Custom Software**


// ab sofort in Vollzeit // in Stuttgart
**Das erwartet dich**
=====================


Als Sales Executive (m/w/d) bist du verantwortlich für die **aktive Gewinnung** neuer Kunden und Projekte im Bereich **Custom Software Development**.


Dein Fokus liegt auf dem **Aufbau von Neugeschäft** vor allem im Mittelstand: Du identifizierst eigenständig neue Opportunities, entwickelst daraus konkrete Deals und führst diese strukturiert bis zum Abschluss.


Du gehst aktiv auf Zielkunden zu, verstehst deren fachliche und technische Herausforderungen und übersetzt diese gemeinsam mit unseren Experten (m/w/d) in überzeugende, **individuelle Lösungsszenarien**.


Mit deinem Blick für Wirtschaftlichkeit, deinem **Drive** im Vertrieb und deiner Neugier auf neue Technologien bringst du Deals erfolgreich zum Abschluss und entwickelst dein Know\-how dank moderner Tools und interner Communities ständig weiter.

  

**Deine Tätigkeiten**
=====================


* Proaktive Akquise von Neukunden im Umfeld individueller Softwarelösungen
* Aufbau eines belastbaren New\-Business\-Funnels
* Eigenständige Ansprache und Entwicklung von Leads
* Steuerung des gesamten Sales Cycles (Discovery bis Closing)
* Durchführung von Bedarfsanalysen auf Entscheidungsebene
* Entwicklung von Angeboten gemeinsam mit dem eingespielten Presales\- und Solution\-Architecture\-Team
* Verhandlung und Abschluss von Projekten
* Verantwortung für Pipeline, Conversion Rates und Abschlussquote
* Präsenz auf Events und in Netzwerken

**Dein Profil**
===============


* Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik, BWL oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Berufserfahrung im B2B\-Software\-Vertrieb
* Erfolge in der Akquise und im Closing komplexer IT\-Projekte
* Verständnis für Custom Software Development
* Strukturierte pipeline\-getriebene Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Eigeninitiative, Abschlussstärke und souveränes Auftreten auf C\-Level Ebene
* Reisebereitschaft
Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse  
*

**Weiterbildung** über Schulungen, interne Workshops, Mentoring Programm uvm.


**Forschungsgruppen** rund um neue Technologien, digitale Produkte und Methoden.


**Onboarding** Programm für den Einstieg.  




**Flexibles Arbeiten** durch Gleitzeit, Hybridmodell (3 Tage vor Ort, bis zu 2 Tage Mobile\-Office/Woche) sowie Workation.

new_jobs.title: Project Engineer – Interfaces (HVDC)
new_jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office –Inverness, Aberdeen, Glasgow or Perth


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £61,600 \+ car/cash allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of the SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works, we are looking for a Project Engineer – Interfaces to join our HVDC Engineering Team.



With several major HVDC projects underway, this is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering one of the UK's most significant energy infrastructure programmes and supporting the transition to Net Zero.



If you’ve developed your career in construction, consultancy, or client organisations and are ready to take on larger, more complex projects, this role will give you the platform to do so.


**You will**


* Manage engineering design interfaces across the multi\-contract delivery strategy, including HVDC, AC, Civils and Cables.


* Own and maintain the Design Interface Registers, working closely with contractors to align inputs, resolve design issues early, and ensure project information remains accurate and up to date.


* Manage the design submittals process through Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), supporting the timely delivery of high\-quality, traceable submissions.


* Act as a key link between SSEN teams and external partners, providing clear communication on interface risks, progress, key decisions and actions.


* Champion a positive safety culture and support compliance with CDM regulations and SSEN's engineering standards throughout the project lifecycle.


* Support the development of interface management best practice across the project, helping colleagues identify, manage and mitigate design and quality risks effectively.


**You have**


* A degree, or equivalent experience, in a relevant engineering discipline (preferably electrical, mechanical or civil engineering). Chartered status, or working towards it, is desirable.


* Proven experience delivering project engineering, design coordination, or interface management activities across complex, multi\-disciplinary projects.


* Proven ability to manage interfaces between teams, contractors, and disciplines, with a track record of identifying interface risks early and implementing effective mitigation measures.


* Experience supporting or leading elements of multi\-disciplinary design coordination, with a good understanding of how design, construction, and programme interdependencies are managed.


* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


* Experience using digital collaboration platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), or similar systems, to manage design submissions, interface registers and structured workflows.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits including a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Hannah on hannah.e.cutajar@sse.com / 01738 341147 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

\#LI\-Hybrid

new_jobs.title: Civil Project Engineer (HVDC)
new_jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office – Caithness, Western Isles, Inverness, Glasgow, Aberdeen or Perth


**Salary:** Up to £65,000 \+ car/ cash allowance \+ annual bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing


**Working Pattern:** Full time\| Permanent \| Flexible Working options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works and beyond, we are looking for a Civil Project Engineer to join the HVDC team to help drive forward our projects and who can bring big ideas, new skills and innovative thinking to help us grow our teams to successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Many of our projects are in the Highlands, Western Isles and Aberdeenshire, so a willingness to travel to that area or locally based engineers are desirable.


**You will**



\- Be responsible for Civil Engineering design and delivery on assigned projects of typical capital value £200M \- £2B.


* Provide technical input for your specialist discipline as well as interfacing with other technical and project functions to ensure a co\-ordinated approach to project delivery and identification and resolution of key risks.


* Promote and manage safety within assigned projects through the implementation of CDM procedures and safety in design as part of your role as Civil Project Engineer. Fulfilling the role of Designer or Principal Designer under CDM.


* Take responsibility for defining scope of civil engineering design and validation and verification of civil engineering designs. Providing ongoing civil engineering support during delivery stages of assigned projects including dealing with RFIs, TQs and PMIs.


* Collaborate with Contractors, Consultants and multi\-disciplinary teams to coordinate and develop robust preliminary, outline, detailed and construction level design information with delivery partners.


* Provide site support as required during the construction phase including site supervision, resolution of design/construction issues and identification of non\-conformances/quality issues and close out of issues.


**You have**


* A degree in an appropriate engineering discipline (preferably CEng or working towards this).


* Demonstrable experience of using digital platforms (Infraworks, Civil 3D, Revit, Navisworks etc.) to facilitate engineering design development and ensure design coordination with other disciplines.


* Good technical knowledge of industry standards, design codes, technical specifications, and how to determine applicability of relevant standards.


* An understanding of CDM Regulations and be proactive in the resolution of issues which affect the constructability of works on site.


* An ability to communicate complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner to facilitate decision making by senior management.


* An appreciation for working in multi\-discipline project teams and enthusiasm to learn about other disciplines and their role in project development and delivery.


* A desire to be involved in both the project development and project delivery aspects of large capital projects with opportunities to be involved in projects from concept to completion.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.

But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.

Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

As part of SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works and beyond, we are looking for a Civil Project Engineer to join the HVDC team to help drive forward our projects and who can bring big ideas, new skills and innovative thinking to help us grow our teams to successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. * Provide site support as required during the construction phase including site supervision, resolution of design/construction issues and identification of non\-conformances/quality issues and close out of issues.

* A degree in an appropriate engineering discipline (preferably CEng or working towards this).


* Demonstrable experience of using digital platforms (Infraworks, Civil 3D, Revit, Navisworks etc.) to facilitate engineering design development and ensure design coordination with other disciplines.


* Good technical knowledge of industry standards, design codes, technical specifications, and how to determine applicability of relevant standards.


* An understanding of CDM Regulations and be proactive in the resolution of issues which affect the constructability of works on site.


* An ability to communicate complex technical issues in a clear and concise manner to facilitate decision making by senior management.


* An appreciation for working in multi\-discipline project teams and enthusiasm to learn about other disciplines and their role in project development and delivery.


* A desire to be involved in both the project development and project delivery aspects of large capital projects with opportunities to be involved in projects from concept to completion.

SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.

SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Hannah on hannah.e.cutajar@sse.com / 01738 341147 to discuss how we can support you.

Reporting to: Director / Associate Director (Building Services)  

  



Team: Building Services Engineering  

  



Location: Sidcup / London / Remote

  

  

  

**Associate Mechanical Design Engineer**

  

Job Specification


Reporting to: Director / Associate Director (Building Services)
  

Team: Building Services Engineering
  

Location: Sidcup, London, Remote
  

  

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate Mechanical Design Engineer to join
  

our Building Services team.
  

  

This is a senior technical and leadership position responsible for managing the design and delivery of
  

mechanical building services projects, leading project teams, developing client relationships, and
  

contributing to the growth and success of the business.
  

  

The successful candidate will combine excellent technical knowledge with strong commercial
  

awareness and leadership skills, ensuring projects are delivered to the highest standards whilst
  

supporting the development of engineers within the team.  

  



  

Main Responsibilities


**Technical Design \& Project Delivery**  

• Lead the mechanical design of building services projects from concept through to completion.
  

* Undertake the role of Lead Mechanical Engineer on projects of varying size and complexity.
* Prepare, review and approve calculations, specifications, reports, schedules and design

drawings.
  

* Produce high\-quality technical designs for HVAC, heating, cooling, ventilation, public health

and renewable energy systems.
  

* Ensure designs comply with current legislation, Building Regulations, British Standards, CIBSE

guidance and client requirements.
  

* Manage project deliverables, programmes and design resources.
* Undertake site inspections, condition surveys and design review meetings.
* Review contractor proposals, technical submissions and commissioning documentation.
* Coordinate with other engineering disciplines, architects, contractors and stakeholders.
* Support sustainable and low\-carbon design solutions in line with current industry best practice.
  

  

**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Mentor, support and develop Mechanical Engineers, Senior Engineers and Technicians.
* Undertake technical reviews and quality checks of design information.
* Lead recruitment, mentoring, appraisal and development of engineering staff within the team.
* Support engineers working towards professional accreditation and chartership.
* Promote a collaborative, positive and high\-performing team culture.

  

  

**Commercial Responsibilities**

* Manage project budgets, fee expenditure and programme performance.
* Monitor project profitability and resource utilisation.
* Assist in fee proposal preparation and scope definition.


Associate Mechanical Design Engineer  

  



  

  

  

* Identify and manage project risks, opportunities and variations.
* Support the achievement of departmental financial targets.
* Contribute to workload forecasting and resource planning.
* Support achievement of annual team utilisation and fee targets.
* Lead preparation of fee proposals and framework submissions.
* Identify new business opportunities with existing and prospective clients.


**Client \& Business Management**  

• Develop and maintain strong client relationships.
  

* Attend client meetings and provide professional technical advice.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional services.
* Assist with framework submissions, tenders and fee proposals.
* Support business development initiatives and networking opportunities.
* Act as a positive ambassador for the business.
  

  

**Quality, Compliance \& Health \& Safety**

* Ensure compliance with company procedures and quality management systems.
* Promote safe design principles in accordance with CDM regulations.
* Maintain awareness of current legislation, standards and industry developments.
* Ensure project documentation is produced and issued in accordance with company standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the mechanical engineering team.

  

  

**Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead and manage a team of Mechanical Engineers and Technicians.
* Undertake annual appraisals and probation reviews.
* Support resource planning and workload allocation.
* Promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence.
* Support succession planning within the team.

  

  

Candidate Specification


**Essential Experience**

* Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a related

discipline.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) and Member of CIBSE, IMechE or equivalent professional

institution.
* Significant experience within a Building Services Consultancy environment.
* Strong technical knowledge of building services design.
* Proven experience leading mechanical design projects.
* Excellent understanding of: HVAC Systems, Heating Systems, Cooling Systems, Ventilation


Systems, Public Health Engineering, Renewable Energy Technologies.
  

* Proficiency with industry standard design software.
* Strong communication and report\-writing skills.
* Excellent project management and organisational abilities.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of project financial management.

Associate Mechanical Design Engineer  

  



  

  

**Desirable Experience**

* Member of CIBSE, IMechE or equivalent professional institution.
* Experience delivering projects using BIM and Revit workflows.
* Knowledge of BREEAM, NABERS and Net Zero design principles.
* Experience across residential, education, healthcare, commercial and public\-sector projects.

  

  

**Key Attributes**

* Technical excellence
* Leadership \& mentoring
* Project management
* Commercial awareness
* Client relationship management
* Communication skills
* Problem solving
* Decision making
* Planning \& organisation
* Business development


Benefits \& Initiatives


Frankham offer excellent benefits and initiatives, including:
  

* Hybrid working policy
* Annual leave \- sell, buy \& carry\-over
* Health Insurance \- Health Shield cash plan
* Long service award
* Incentive scheme
* Frankham Friday
* Professional qualification support
* Cycle\-to\-work scheme
* Death in service
* Annual season ticket loan
* Generous maternity \& paternity pay
  

  

  

About Frankham Group


Frankham is a top 50 multi\-disciplinary built environment consultancy. For over 40 years, we have
  

delivered integrated Design, Surveying and Project Management, Infrastructure Engineering, and Risk
  

Management solutions to the built environment. We combine technical expertise with a commitment
  

to bringing ideas to life.
  

  

Following investment by LDC in March 2026, Frankham Group is entering a pivotal phase of
  

growth and transformation. The business is evolving from a collection of highly entrepreneurial
  

divisions into a more connected, scalable and strategically aligned organisation capable of
  

delivering accelerated growth, operational excellence and long\-term value creation.  

  



Associate Mechanical Design Engineer  

  



  

  

  

As part of this next stage of development, we are seeking an experienced and commercially astute
  

legal professional to establish, lead and develop the Group's legal function. The successful candidate
  

will provide strategic and operational legal leadership across all areas of the business, supporting
  

commercial growth whilst ensuring legal, contractual and regulatory risks are effectively managed.
  

  

Acting as a trusted adviser to the Board, Executive Leadership Team and operational management
  

teams, the role will play a pivotal part in protecting and enhancing the Group's interests, enabling
  

sustainable growth and supporting key strategic initiatives including acquisitions, business integration
  

and market expansion.

Join Capgemini’s Cloud \& Custom Applications (C\&CΑ) practice, where we help clients transform business outcomes through modern application engineering, intelligent automation, and AI\-enabled innovation. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.


**About Capgemini:**


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.
